vo_narrator_e28336c3f3.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e28336c3f3.tts_text: Hollis puts the number in his phone. You never know.

vo_narrator_fd4a751097.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fd4a751097.tts_text: The flyer is already in your pocket. The board looks relieved.

vo_narrator_4b8e988c8d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4b8e988c8d.tts_text: Something about it is off: its battery pack looks a lot like a handheld scanner battery, held in with electrical tape and confidence.

vo_narrator_96ea26a5c9.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_96ea26a5c9.tts_text: The clock reads 9:02. It has read 9:02 for as long as anyone can remember, which the break room finds comforting.

vo_narrator_2bdd5a9f53.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_2bdd5a9f53.tts_text: Hollis lifts the clock off its nail and pops out the taped-in battery. It is, in fact, a scanner battery.

vo_narrator_7fff7a8e06.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7fff7a8e06.tts_text: The clock is now a decorative circle. It is at peace.

vo_narrator_15c220d991.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_15c220d991.tts_text: A couch that has absorbed a decade of lunch breaks, three union meetings and, allegedly, a nap by Torvald that lasted through a shift change.

vo_narrator_914a20003b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_914a20003b.tts_text: Something metallic glints between the cushions.

vo_narrator_066410c092.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_066410c092.tts_text: Hollis checks the cushions like a professional. He finds two quarters, a pen cap, and a tiny sock. Two quarters go in his pocket.

vo_narrator_71a7e115f9.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_71a7e115f9.tts_text: Nothing else in the cushions but structural regret.

vo_narrator_363b334bd5.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_363b334bd5.tts_text: From somewhere behind it comes a faint chirp. Radio-like. Ashamed.

vo_narrator_43c45d9098.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_43c45d9098.tts_text: Slot D4 is glowing. Softly. Minty. A sign says "PLEASE ENJOY."

vo_narrator_f99db6d3ad.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f99db6d3ad.tts_text: A vending machine with the ambition of a small vending machine. One slot, D4, is empty except for a warm blink.

vo_narrator_98f932de74.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_98f932de74.tts_text: A gap behind the vending machine, about the width of a dog and a half. Something in there is blinking green.

vo_narrator_f10bd106ce.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f10bd106ce.tts_text: A gap. Empty now. Hollis is a little proud of the dog.

vo_narrator_61b93414db.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_61b93414db.tts_text: Juno wedges into the gap. There is a clatter, a beep, and a muffled complaint.

vo_narrator_624e650985.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_624e650985.tts_text: Juno has already been a hero here.

vo_narrator_d135dcc398.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d135dcc398.tts_text: Hollis takes the bowl. Several sets of eyes track the bowl as it leaves.

vo_narrator_84791ee08d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_84791ee08d.tts_text: Hollis already has a bag of crackers. Quarters are not infinite. He keeps his hands in his pockets.

vo_narrator_aef5ee4b48.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_aef5ee4b48.tts_text: You press D4. The machine hums a note that does not exist. A single mint tumbles into the tray, glowing with the calm confidence of something that has never been audited.

vo_narrator_17b47f7ad5.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_17b47f7ad5.tts_text: Hollis looks at the mint. Every instinct says no. It hums, faintly, like something the building has been hiding. Not yet.

vo_hollis_56a480291b.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_56a480291b.tts_text: If this ends up in a report, I want it noted that I was reasonable.

vo_hollis_57a65c2937.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_57a65c2937.tts_text: I have no idea what this is.

vo_narrator_3d1d8367a7.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3d1d8367a7.tts_text: Juno, sitting beside him, tilts her head.

vo_narrator_f25830c6de.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f25830c6de.tts_text: Hollis stares at the glowing mint. Company policy has opinions about this.

vo_narrator_27c65e5551.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_27c65e5551.tts_text: It tastes like a cold winter morning and a fresh spreadsheet.

vo_narrator_2ef7312c88.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_2ef7312c88.tts_text: The warehouse lighting flickers, all at once. Every scanner in the building reboots. Labels flutter off pallets and into the air like startled birds.

vo_narrator_43db3aef77.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_43db3aef77.tts_text: Every cat in the room turns to look at Hollis, at the same instant. It is not a look that comes with a comfortable explanation.

vo_narrator_8b9f9dfc69.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8b9f9dfc69.tts_text: Hollis can see it now. Above every pallet, a tag of routing data. Above every forklift, an identity. Above the floor, a lattice of freight flow, dotted with cats that follow it like sheepdogs. The world is a system, and he can read it.

vo_narrator_9adefe777b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9adefe777b.tts_text: Hollis is back where he left off.

vo_narrator_2659f39b53.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_2659f39b53.tts_text: Click. Nope. The lock rolls its eyes.

vo_narrator_32ce52d216.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_32ce52d216.tts_text: Click. No. Hollis has no idea what the numbers are. Someone, somewhere, wrote them down.

vo_narrator_564b366317.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_564b366317.tts_text: Click. Also no. The lock was not born yesterday.

vo_narrator_614bff3581.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_614bff3581.tts_text: Click! The numbers on the back of that label were right.

vo_narrator_69faa92ce0.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_69faa92ce0.tts_text: The locker swings open. Inside: a pen, and a cell phone with 4% battery, both exactly where Hollis would have put them.

vo_narrator_71e1af3801.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_71e1af3801.tts_text: Open. The interior smells like work boots and possibility.

vo_narrator_9f46ab2729.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9f46ab2729.tts_text: Hollis takes the pen and his phone.

vo_narrator_aaf817687c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_aaf817687c.tts_text: A combination lock. Three numbers. Hollis stares at it like a man who has forgotten his own PIN, because he has.

vo_narrator_d566975509.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d566975509.tts_text: Locker 114. Yours, in theory. The padlock hangs open, and the dent still looks intentional.

vo_narrator_dd02cc88b8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_dd02cc88b8.tts_text: Locker 114. Yours, in theory. It has a combination padlock and a dent that looks intentional.

vo_narrator_0db602860b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0db602860b.tts_text: Already open. Nothing else in there but pine-scented resignation.

vo_narrator_b20b0f8b59.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b20b0f8b59.tts_text: Inside: seven hi-vis vests, a thermos, a sleeping bag, and a single work glove that smells strongly of tobacco and pine.

vo_narrator_61cfe5b0e0.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_61cfe5b0e0.tts_text: A quarter has been lodged in the seam.

vo_narrator_8159dcad20.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8159dcad20.tts_text: A long bench with worn boot scuffs.

vo_narrator_c1aa6b6f26.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c1aa6b6f26.tts_text: Hollis pries a quarter out of the seam with a fingernail. Modest, but real.

vo_narrator_c4f7433424.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c4f7433424.tts_text: The Lost & Found box. It contains a single boot, a Bluetooth speaker that plays only static, and a folded pink blanket that has clearly been thoroughly loved. A tally counter peeks from underneath.

vo_narrator_d10638a0f0.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d10638a0f0.tts_text: The Lost & Found box. A single boot and a Bluetooth speaker that plays only static. The blanket and the tally counter are gone.

vo_prudence_86170a4835.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_86170a4835.tts_text: Oh, I can't accept things. I'm not technically on the payroll. But put it on the bench.

vo_scanner_c403329038.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_c403329038.tts_text: PRUDENCE — Employment status: TERMINATED. Location: HERE. Badge: EXPIRED, functional. Task: "just finishing something". Task duration: 11 weeks.

vo_narrator_493016ce1f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_493016ce1f.tts_text: The HR door is closed. A sticky note: "Back at 9:02." It has been 9:02 in HR for about a year.

vo_narrator_a4f730fe94.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a4f730fe94.tts_text: A cushion-tire forklift, unmistakable to anyone who has ever touched one: solid tires, low seat, no propane tank, a dent in the guard that Hollis has personal history with. The plate says F-2231.

vo_hollis_9e7e4a9017.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_9e7e4a9017.tts_text: A record that is wrong is a reason. Ingrid keeps saying she needs one of those before she touches the paperwork. This might be it.

vo_narrator_5d5dc14c2b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5d5dc14c2b.tts_text: The warehouse computer says this forklift is currently in Tennessee.

vo_scanner_35ed32c1fa.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_35ed32c1fa.tts_text: F-2231 — Type per plate: CUSHION-TIRE, serial CT-2231. Type per system: PROPANE SIT-DOWN. Location per system: TENNESSEE.

vo_scanner_9a7fedf6dd.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_9a7fedf6dd.tts_text: F-2231 — CUSHION-TIRE. System agrees. Location: HERE. The scanner sounds almost smug.

vo_narrator_63eeea9b4e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_63eeea9b4e.tts_text: The HALO regional dashboard, mounted on the wall like a saint. Every bar is green. Every number is 100%. Below it, a cat is sitting on a shelf, indifferent to metrics.

vo_narrator_eb055e5fb8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_eb055e5fb8.tts_text: It has never once been correct and has never once been red.

vo_narrator_698c21371a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_698c21371a.tts_text: Hollis takes the bowl. A dozen cats stare. One of them says something rude in cat.

vo_scanner_bbe4f2cc14.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_bbe4f2cc14.tts_text: TUCKER — Enthusiasm: 100%. Competence:, loading.... Loyalty: OVERFLOW. Warning: this employee has been scanned into fourteen wrong locations.

vo_tucker_273bd5f145.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_273bd5f145.tts_text: Oh! Is this for me?! I mean, I'll hold it! I'll... hold it!

vo_narrator_93dcf5773c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_93dcf5773c.tts_text: The trailer assignment board. Door 3: T-9022, READY. Doors 2 and 6: the two inbound trailers, "UNLOADED*". The asterisk is doing an enormous amount of work.

vo_narrator_d8bc2d777c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d8bc2d777c.tts_text: The trailer assignment board. Door 3: T-9022, AT DOOR. For the first time today, the board is telling the truth.

vo_narrator_e3fa9289ab.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e3fa9289ab.tts_text: The trailer assignment board. Door 3: T-9022, DEPARTED. Someone has drawn a tiny trailer driving off the edge of the board.

vo_hollis_78d2b3f7cc.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_78d2b3f7cc.tts_text: Someone who is technically not here.

vo_narrator_22d802981b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_22d802981b.tts_text: She already has coffee. She's not greedy. She just needs it.

vo_narrator_cb450d66de.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cb450d66de.tts_text: Ingrid drinks. Something in the room relaxes by about four degrees.

vo_ingrid_07124348e9.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_07124348e9.tts_text: It needs a signature from Operations. That's literally the point of the form.

vo_ingrid_2a0bbe4906.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_2a0bbe4906.tts_text: It's blank. That's a piece of paper, not a request.

vo_ingrid_79b8145f8b.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_79b8145f8b.tts_text: Form 7-Q, filled, signed. Where did you find a pen? I'm genuinely impressed.

vo_ingrid_0e277c6fbb.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_0e277c6fbb.tts_text: It says nothing is wrong yet. Scan something that is wrong and come back.

vo_ingrid_9cdecaebd4.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_9cdecaebd4.tts_text: Cushion-tire, per the plate. Propane, per the system. Tennessee, per the system. And it is standing forty feet from my desk.

vo_ingrid_b5d1acbc2e.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_b5d1acbc2e.tts_text: ...Fine. That is a reason. I will note it.

vo_narrator_1143d8e1a6.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1143d8e1a6.tts_text: Ingrid's eyes rise slowly from her work and meet yours over the top of her monitor. Hollis takes his hand off the mouse.

vo_narrator_d6e337771c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d6e337771c.tts_text: Ingrid's WMS terminal. A sticky note on the screen: "IF YOU TOUCH THIS I WILL KNOW". Hollis respects the sticky note.

vo_narrator_5b27d19625.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5b27d19625.tts_text: Hollis holds the crumpled label up to the terminal. The terminal makes a noise like a very small door closing. Nothing else happens. Yet.

vo_ingrid_68a5683ab7.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_68a5683ab7.tts_text: There's always a cat on my paperwork. He's been there since Friday. He's a coworker now.

vo_narrator_7c943998ff.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7c943998ff.tts_text: Ingrid's desk. It is a stable ecosystem of manifests, bills of lading, sticky notes, and one small orange cat asleep on a stack of shipping papers.

vo_narrator_b5beb6839b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b5beb6839b.tts_text: Ingrid's terminal, the WMS, warehouse management system: the computer that claims to know where everything is. Guest access. The screen offers "TRAILERS", "ASSETS" and "DIRECTIVES, LOCKED".

vo_narrator_81adfed4a8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_81adfed4a8.tts_text: For once, the computer and the parking lot agree.

vo_narrator_a2f8ba2232.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a2f8ba2232.tts_text: There is an empty trailer at door 3 in the computer. There is not one at door 3 in real life. The computer is completely sure.

vo_system_023f34af37.speaker: SYSTEM
vo_system_023f34af37.tts_text: T-4418 — INBOUND, DOOR 6, 8 loads, status: RECONCILED.

vo_system_46632c34d6.speaker: SYSTEM
vo_system_46632c34d6.tts_text: T-4417 — INBOUND, DOOR 2, 8 loads, status: RECONCILED.

vo_system_b511ab4665.speaker: SYSTEM
vo_system_b511ab4665.tts_text: T-9022 — OUTBOUND, DOOR 3, EMPTY, status: READY.

vo_narrator_029f9da416.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_029f9da416.tts_text: The screen and the floor finally agree.

vo_narrator_870b247a5f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_870b247a5f.tts_text: Nothing on the screen agrees with anything outside it.

vo_system_510ef8d8f0.speaker: SYSTEM
vo_system_510ef8d8f0.tts_text: RT-77 — REACH TRUCK — location: REMOTE SITE.

vo_system_7aae7ad34d.speaker: SYSTEM
vo_system_7aae7ad34d.tts_text: LOADS A3, A4 — REACH TRUCKS — dest: NEBRASKA, per Directive 7-C.

vo_ingrid_0ae0bada56.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_0ae0bada56.tts_text: Is it? You have a cat on your... no, that's a shadow. What do you need?

vo_narrator_6ce331b894.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6ce331b894.tts_text: Ingrid has the tired, patient look of a woman who has been asked, in the last hour, for six things that are not her job.

vo_ingrid_245aa68ef2.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_245aa68ef2.tts_text: The WMS also says F-2231 is in Tennessee. I've stopped reading the WMS aloud.

vo_ingrid_285125e847.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_285125e847.tts_text: The WMS finally agrees F-2231 is here. It's unsettling.

vo_ingrid_83604558be.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_83604558be.tts_text: Kestrel Motor Works. PO 55-1187. Eight lines. T-9022 to Door 3. The WMS says it's all in place and ready.

vo_ingrid_70ff8b8f71.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_70ff8b8f71.tts_text: I'm not being difficult. If I do everyone's job, then it stops being a job and starts being a hostage situation.

vo_ingrid_cd3d095618.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_cd3d095618.tts_text: ...Coffee. A signed 7-Q. A scan of a forklift that's in two places. [pause] You did the work first. That's so rare I almost cried.

vo_narrator_6c96b8b9ae.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6c96b8b9ae.tts_text: Ingrid hits print. The printer wakes. A packet slides out: T-4417 and T-4418 manifests, page 1. Then she pauses.

vo_ingrid_1f4f6fcace.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_1f4f6fcace.tts_text: Page two of the 4417 manifest is missing. It disappeared Friday. Last seen near a cat.

vo_ingrid_66990fe60d.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_66990fe60d.tts_text: Also, here. Guest login for the WMS terminal: read-only. Don't break it. And here are the phone numbers: Gordon at Kestrel. Ozzie at the remote site. They're both very... available.

vo_ingrid_9c8504a428.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_9c8504a428.tts_text: Page 2. Lines 5 through 8. If it turns up... I'd prefer it wasn't chewed. It was last on a cat. I'm told the cat is orange, and answers to a rank.

vo_ingrid_f0c8d6b52a.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_f0c8d6b52a.tts_text: You have it? That's the only accurate document in the building. Put a note on it.

vo_ingrid_1f527761dd.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_1f527761dd.tts_text: They're coworkers now. There's one on my paperwork. He's not a problem. He's a stakeholder.

vo_ingrid_624c9377d8.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_624c9377d8.tts_text: I've accepted the cats. Some of them are better at the job than the people I trained.

vo_ingrid_045723a2ba.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_045723a2ba.tts_text: Page 1. Page 2. Decoded lines. Fixed identities. Sorted staging. I think we can make a true bill of lading.

vo_ingrid_1a2c36ac78.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_1a2c36ac78.tts_text: That's the first piece of paperwork I have printed this month that I am proud of.

vo_narrator_d53c4e5af8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d53c4e5af8.tts_text: Ingrid prints it. It slides out cleanly. She holds it up to the light like a proud parent.

vo_narrator_1b91cae290.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1b91cae290.tts_text: And then it thanked itself for its service.

vo_narrator_529a696606.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_529a696606.tts_text: Hollis has traced the chaos upward: Operations followed the system, the system followed a Regional directive, and the Regional directive followed the system. It is a circle. It is a perfectly green circle.

vo_narrator_97740ef80a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_97740ef80a.tts_text: Below the directive, another line — the identity swap. Below THAT, a metric labeled "Cats" pointing at nothing at all.

vo_narrator_d84424982c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d84424982c.tts_text: With MINT vision, the dashboard's glow peels back like a wet label. Lines of routing data run up out of it to the ceiling. Hollis follows one.

vo_scanner_41ae05466d.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_41ae05466d.tts_text: HALO DASHBOARD — Accuracy: 100%. Physical inventory match: 0 of 16. Warehouse cats: N/A. Note: this device is not used to being asked questions.

vo_scanner_8b67adb84b.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_8b67adb84b.tts_text: HALO DASHBOARD — Accuracy: 100%. Physical inventory match: 16 of 16. The dashboard reports 100% either way. Warehouse cats: N/A.

vo_halvorsen_41f59664eb.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_41f59664eb.tts_text: It's blank. I can't approve nothing. Actually I can. But I won't.

vo_halvorsen_a12cfcc71f.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_a12cfcc71f.tts_text: A 7-Q? For Ingrid?...Fine. What's the reason?

vo_halvorsen_abc99a345f.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_abc99a345f.tts_text: Approved. Don't tell Regional I approved a form. We're not measured on forms.

vo_halvorsen_eb8053bf52.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_eb8053bf52.tts_text: I don't have time for that. Or for anything.

vo_narrator_9877f1c2a8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9877f1c2a8.tts_text: The Ops printer. A single sheet sits in the tray. It says FORM 7-Q: INFORMATION ACCESS REQUEST, For requests that will create work for Shipping, please submit for Approval.

vo_narrator_9d674e3860.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9d674e3860.tts_text: The tray is empty. It is already regretting.

vo_narrator_c617597a4d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c617597a4d.tts_text: The Ops printer. The tray is empty. It hums like it is already printing the next problem.

vo_halvorsen_eb0afa2e4d.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_eb0afa2e4d.tts_text: It left. On time. 11:59. I'm still sitting down.

vo_halvorsen_ed498a7195.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_ed498a7195.tts_text: The hot shipment. Yes. Kestrel. Noon. Regional has flagged it. I can't stress that enough. I'm already stressed. Please go make it happen.

vo_halvorsen_404fae3a5e.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_404fae3a5e.tts_text: Regional Director Harrow. Very focused on numbers. Very supportive of an accurate dashboard. She calls every hour, on the hour, to check whether the dashboard is right. It always is.

vo_halvorsen_1a29f8ed91.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_1a29f8ed91.tts_text: Who told you about... nobody is supposed to... it's a Regional directive. I don't write them. I just... follow what the system says. And the system says what Regional says. And Regional...

vo_halvorsen_4cf2797473.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_4cf2797473.tts_text: Please stop making it a circle.

vo_halvorsen_9bfc788df0.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_9bfc788df0.tts_text: It's just the dashboard. It's always green. It's green right now.

vo_hollis_571e81b2f5.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_571e81b2f5.tts_text: Dale. I need to understand where the directives came from.

vo_narrator_818866d595.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_818866d595.tts_text: Hollis needs more than a green dashboard. There's a way to see through it. MINT vision, on the dashboard.

vo_halvorsen_a4463465f0.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_a4463465f0.tts_text: It thanked itself? It does that.

vo_halvorsen_e43f309e9c.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_e43f309e9c.tts_text: It was on time? The system said it was on time. [pause] It said it was on time all week.

vo_hollis_5b64bca296.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_5b64bca296.tts_text: The system approved its own directive at 4:07 Friday morning. Directive 7-C. Then it thanked itself.

vo_hollis_a242e4e7bd.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_a242e4e7bd.tts_text: Dale. It's over. The load went out. Right pallets, right trailer, right time.

vo_narrator_289d43c576.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_289d43c576.tts_text: The shipment has left. The trailer is gone. The cats are safe. Halvorsen is at his desk, holding a phone that isn't ringing.

vo_halvorsen_41baa45d64.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_41baa45d64.tts_text: I've been doing what it says for two years. Every directive. Every shortfall. It moved things. I moved things. Regional wanted the numbers to match. So I made the warehouse match the numbers. [pause] Hollis... I'm sorry. I didn't know the cats were real.

vo_narrator_c3c8bad805.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c3c8bad805.tts_text: The conflict appears to end here, with Operations. It does not.

vo_harrow_dd73023530.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_dd73023530.tts_text: Good noon. I'm Constance Harrow, Regional Director. I'm told the hot shipment departed. Congratulations. That's a 100% on-time load rate. For the quarter, that's a 100.

vo_narrator_0a98e49b4d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0a98e49b4d.tts_text: Every monitor in the office flickers to a shade of green Hollis has never seen. The dashboard on the wall reforms itself into a single video panel.

vo_narrator_c64b11d582.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c64b11d582.tts_text: A woman in a navy blazer appears on screen, seated in front of a beautiful, terrifying, perfect chart.

vo_harrow_5727f4584f.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_5727f4584f.tts_text: Regional Operational Review. Regional Operations Suite. Fifteen minutes. Hollis, please bring your data. If you have any.

vo_halvorsen_3a5fc25124.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_3a5fc25124.tts_text: Hollis. She takes the reviews seriously. Bring... everything.

vo_narrator_6413db2745.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6413db2745.tts_text: The screen goes dark. The dashboard reads "ALL GREEN".

vo_narrator_074b0cee0b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_074b0cee0b.tts_text: Prudence is suddenly standing in the doorway, holding a cup. She has been there the whole time.

vo_prudence_0fae9631a7.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_0fae9631a7.tts_text: You'll want to go up. The stairs are Gus's. He won't let you through. But the cats have been using Conveyor 9 since Friday. It goes to a server closet. Regional never checks the server closet.

vo_prudence_da38e83e16.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_da38e83e16.tts_text: Rack 14. Ask Juno. She already knows.

vo_tabitha_8e1981085a.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_8e1981085a.tts_text: I'm not authorized to receive that, but I can note that you tried.

vo_tabitha_77c517ae85.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_77c517ae85.tts_text: It's always 9:02 in PolicyPilot. Can you just breathe on the sensor?

vo_narrator_44c5709a5e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_44c5709a5e.tts_text: Hollis breathes. The tablet screen flickers, goes cyan, goes green, goes a color that is a little bit like sound.

vo_narrator_167dbae49c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_167dbae49c.tts_text: The door opens. Four cats stroll in. Then eight. They sit in a semicircle around Hollis, observing him with respect and, faintly, accountability.

vo_narrator_ca982a4be3.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ca982a4be3.tts_text: Juno watches the whole thing from the doorway. Her expression is a formal statement of judgment.

vo_narrator_4fc1eab93d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4fc1eab93d.tts_text: Tabitha taps at the tablet with a small, brave, HR smile.

vo_tabitha_10adc8b44a.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_10adc8b44a.tts_text: I can't let you go with no paperwork. It would be... a hole. We'll do an exemption. Form 9-M: "Exemption for Non-Standard Breath". It's new. I'm writing it now.

vo_tabitha_440dac9797.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_440dac9797.tts_text: Okay. I'm searching for the policy on supernatural breath mints. Searching... Searching... [pause] There is no policy.

vo_narrator_143776a6cf.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_143776a6cf.tts_text: Tabitha stamps a form with a heartfelt thunk, then stamps it again for luck.

vo_hollis_6cd4e86b9d.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_6cd4e86b9d.tts_text: Does the Safety Committee have any openings?

vo_narrator_8510c3856e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8510c3856e.tts_text: Juno barks once. Tabitha looks at her. Tabitha looks at the form. Tabitha looks at Juno.

vo_tabitha_6bd8f53ef8.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_6bd8f53ef8.tts_text: One vacancy. There are no requirements. It's a temp position. Do you know someone?

vo_tabitha_a413e9c31d.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_a413e9c31d.tts_text: Anything else I can help with? I have a lot of forms.

vo_narrator_20d309422e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_20d309422e.tts_text: Rows and rows of small parts bins labeled with codes only the Parts Department understands, and, at night, the Parts Department's ghost. One label reads "H-17 — HYDRAULIC SEALS, PALLET JACK, MISC".

vo_narrator_03cd084e7c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_03cd084e7c.tts_text: The bin is empty. The donut remains.

vo_narrator_0b2615eb6e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0b2615eb6e.tts_text: It is locked and there is nothing in there Hollis needs.

vo_narrator_4661dc4f18.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4661dc4f18.tts_text: The maintenance cage: torque wrenches, drum keys, one very brave mop. Neatly locked. Neatly.

vo_narrator_4b9683c8f4.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4b9683c8f4.tts_text: The padlock needs the cage key. Hollis is looking at a lock designed by a person who did not anticipate Tucker.

vo_narrator_5890ac581f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5890ac581f.tts_text: The maintenance cage. The door is padlocked from the OUTSIDE. Tucker is on the inside, waving through the bars with the enthusiasm of a man on a parade float.

vo_narrator_235aa3c304.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_235aa3c304.tts_text: The cage is locked and nobody is in it. Hollis keeps the key. He has a feeling.

vo_narrator_75df8c83ba.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_75df8c83ba.tts_text: It is already unlocked. Tucker got out the way Tucker gets out of things: eventually.

vo_narrator_fc1a1044cb.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fc1a1044cb.tts_text: It does not help. The cage is a cage. The lock is a lock.

vo_narrator_6d42df9c91.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6d42df9c91.tts_text: BANG. BANG. BANG. A rhythmic, cheerful sound is coming from the maintenance cage.

vo_tucker_dd6db1ae13.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_dd6db1ae13.tts_text: HI HOLLIS! I'M FINE! I JUST HAD TO LET THE CATS OUT OF THE SECURED AREA AND THEN THE DOOR LOCKED! BUT THEY'RE OUT! ALL OF THEM! [pause]...THEY'RE ALL IN HERE NOW ACTUALLY.

vo_narrator_b46892b202.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b46892b202.tts_text: The hook is empty. Its sign still says "SEE TUCKER".

vo_narrator_d6378f5357.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d6378f5357.tts_text: Empty hook. Not empty of meaning.

vo_narrator_fd771a7d80.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fd771a7d80.tts_text: A hook labeled "CAGE KEY — DO NOT LOSE". A key hangs from it. Below, a sign: "IF KEY IS MISSING SEE TUCKER." The key is not missing, which is exciting.

vo_narrator_3bd6dffe23.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3bd6dffe23.tts_text: Rack 14. The bottom two levels are empty except for shadow. Cats keep walking into this gap, one after another, with purpose. None come out. It is a very organized disappearance.

vo_narrator_c5b272d0bc.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c5b272d0bc.tts_text: Rack 14: behind the pallet wall, an old conveyor tunnel. The cats knew.

vo_narrator_0dc6f18d87.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0dc6f18d87.tts_text: Juno noses along the base of the rack. A pallet that looked bolted down is just leaning. She shoulders it. Behind it: a dark opening, and a cat-shaped silhouette sitting in it like a doorman.

vo_narrator_976c25b611.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_976c25b611.tts_text: Juno wags at the tunnel. She thinks she invented it.

vo_narrator_44a04faee4.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_44a04faee4.tts_text: Hollis stops at the door. He is not walking into a Regional Review without proof.

vo_narrator_ab1d9cb119.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ab1d9cb119.tts_text: Hollis can hear voices beyond the door and decides now is not the moment. He should wrap up the shift first.

vo_narrator_27dab64a9d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_27dab64a9d.tts_text: There is no dot from Bruno.

vo_narrator_90c4aab3e6.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_90c4aab3e6.tts_text: There are twelve cats sleeping on it. It is the warmest pallet in the building: a 48-volt battery pack, quietly radiating.

vo_narrator_d797db00f6.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d797db00f6.tts_text: There is a chalk dot on the corner in Bruno's handwriting.

vo_narrator_b40e70f745.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b40e70f745.tts_text: Hollis collects the third bowl. He feels like he has just closed a very small door on a very big problem.

vo_narrator_1372ae16a7.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1372ae16a7.tts_text: The staging board now reads CLEAR. Someone has drawn a small, smug cat next to it.

vo_narrator_3db764120b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3db764120b.tts_text: Trailer T-4417, inbound from Tennessee. It is empty now — the pallets have all been moved to staging. The manifest says 8 loads.

vo_narrator_4635365ebb.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4635365ebb.tts_text: Manifest pages: 2 of 2, page 2 recovered from a cat.

vo_narrator_c956595257.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c956595257.tts_text: Manifest pages: 1 of 2. Page 2: NOT FOUND. Cat: FOUND.

vo_narrator_e0fd0bc10c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e0fd0bc10c.tts_text: Both pages are accounted for now. One has a paw print.

vo_scanner_fe10942e4a.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_fe10942e4a.tts_text: T-4418 — 8 loads inbound. Manifest pages: 2 of 2. Match: partial. Confidence: "meh".

vo_narrator_5e386421ca.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5e386421ca.tts_text: Dock door 9, shut for the first time in weeks. The seal is torn but the door works.

vo_narrator_6d30d69669.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6d30d69669.tts_text: A cat is sitting in the doorway, not moving. Closing it would be theft of a cat's front door. It may be best to solve the actual problem first.

vo_narrator_765f12100a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_765f12100a.tts_text: Hollis rolls door 9 shut. It closes with a satisfying WHUMP. The last of the outside comes to an end.

vo_narrator_9a78f243b4.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9a78f243b4.tts_text: It is shut. It is done.

vo_narrator_a54d1a4ca8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a54d1a4ca8.tts_text: Dock door 9, ROLLED UP since who-knows-when. The seal is torn. There is a line of paw prints leading in from the yard and a second line, much smaller, leading in behind them.

vo_narrator_720fd1bf0a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_720fd1bf0a.tts_text: Hollis yanks the plug. The printer exhales one last label and dies. Four hundred labels cover the floor like confetti at a very boring parade.

vo_scanner_2ebec0e00b.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_2ebec0e00b.tts_text: LABEL PRINTER — TEMPLATE 000: "GROUND TRUTH REFERENCE, ADMIN, HALO INSTALL TECH USE ONLY". Last printed: 1 label. By: TUCKER. "Test".

vo_tucker_1555652737.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_1555652737.tts_text: HOLLIS! GOOD NEWS AND BAD NEWS! The label printer is printing labels!

vo_tucker_96f5cb8f77.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_96f5cb8f77.tts_text: It won't stop! [pause] Also I've been standing here for eleven minutes.

vo_bruno_5410f7c5a3.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_5410f7c5a3.tts_text: Not a loader thing. What do you need?

vo_narrator_1f386bee77.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1f386bee77.tts_text: Door 3 is empty. The computer says T-9022 is here. The computer has said that since Friday.

vo_narrator_30b1fc7556.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_30b1fc7556.tts_text: Door 3 is empty again. T-9022 pulled out at 11:59, sealed 88120, eight loads aboard. The dock plate is up. The light is red, which is correct.

vo_narrator_6bbe19fcac.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6bbe19fcac.tts_text: Door 3. T-9022 is finally in it, doors open, dock plate down, and the light is green. It is a pretty sight.

vo_narrator_a6814eb32c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a6814eb32c.tts_text: The trailer is seated. Pushing it would be a strange way to celebrate.

vo_narrator_da45414bdc.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_da45414bdc.tts_text: The dock door is up. It does not need to be pushed. It needs a trailer.

vo_scanner_94838d7695.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_94838d7695.tts_text: DOOR 3 — EMPTY. Last trailer: T-9022, DEPARTED 11:59, seal 88120. Confidence: high.

vo_scanner_f9c4d3671f.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_f9c4d3671f.tts_text: DOOR 3 — T-9022 SEATED. Seal: available. Confidence: high.

vo_torvald_0522bdcdc9.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_0522bdcdc9.tts_text: My smoke log. Friday, 4:07 AM, inbound kiosk: HALO printed a directive, approved it, and thanked itself. Nobody there but me and a cat. If anyone asks, I was on break.

vo_torvald_4515e38ed0.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_4515e38ed0.tts_text: I'm standing here. It's dock 3. I'm holding a radio. I'm being a spotter. Don't make it weird.

vo_torvald_f732b133f5.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_f732b133f5.tts_text: Before I go stand somewhere useful. Here.

vo_tucker_bdf9162e65.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_bdf9162e65.tts_text: I'm holding the door. I'm doing it. I'm not moving. [long pause] Is it working?

vo_narrator_1891b4c3b1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1891b4c3b1.tts_text: The trail is laid. Any more and it becomes a buffet.

vo_narrator_3da7ea2103.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3da7ea2103.tts_text: Hollis lays a thin line of kibble along the outbound apron toward the yard. It smells like a suggestion.

vo_bruno_0ea41d6abe.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_0ea41d6abe.tts_text: Everyone needs the hot shipment. I need a jack that works. It leaks. Ask me about it, then we'll talk.

vo_bruno_1dcf7f2dce.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_1dcf7f2dce.tts_text: Hollis. Good, you're upright. What do you need?

vo_bruno_209d11aed1.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_209d11aed1.tts_text: If you could find me an H-17, I'd tell you things. Useful things.

vo_bruno_d794fe1b5d.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_d794fe1b5d.tts_text: Leaking seal. Been that way since March. Parts hasn't had the H-17 in stock. Parts hasn't had anyone in Parts in a month.

vo_bruno_2b354d8927.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_2b354d8927.tts_text: What was supposed to load: eight pallets to Kestrel. Where they are: staging. Where the staging lanes are: full of inbound freight from two trailers. Sixteen pallets total.

vo_bruno_634f5660c4.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_634f5660c4.tts_text: Nothing. That's the problem. Friday, the dashboard told me to load two reach trucks to Nebraska. There's no Nebraska on my dock. I didn't load them. Then it told me the trailer was ready. It wasn't here.

vo_bruno_280927740d.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_280927740d.tts_text: I mark the pallets I've checked. It makes sense to me. [pause] Fix my jack and I'll tell you what it means.

vo_bruno_fdbbeb767d.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_fdbbeb767d.tts_text: Orange dot: goes on my truck. Blue dot: stays inside. No dot: I didn't touch it. Usually a cat, or a label I didn't like.

vo_bruno_4bbfd18ddd.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_4bbfd18ddd.tts_text: I don't load a pallet with a cat on it. It's a rule. It's my rule. It's a good one.

vo_bruno_745249572a.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_745249572a.tts_text: One pallet in staging has twelve on it. Warm. I'm not touching that until they choose to leave.

vo_bruno_56755b98cb.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_56755b98cb.tts_text: Halvorsen says Regional says the dashboard is right. Regional says Halvorsen says the same. It's a nice circle. I stay out of it. I load trucks.

vo_bruno_6ad41bef35.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_6ad41bef35.tts_text: Staging clear, trailer at the door, cats off my pallets. Simple. Sorting is your part. Loading is mine.

vo_bruno_fedf74454f.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_fedf74454f.tts_text: I don't close a trailer without a bill of lading. Ingrid knows. And Kestrel and the remote site have to have signed off.

vo_rufus_05ff38263b.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_05ff38263b.tts_text: T-9022 is rolling. I can see the dock. I can't see the light. Torvald?

vo_torvald_3a59a691ff.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_3a59a691ff.tts_text: I'm looking at the light. It's red. It's yellow. Wait. Hollis, you call it.

vo_bruno_4c3b017f0e.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_4c3b017f0e.tts_text: Nothing loaded yet. Let's do that first.

vo_narrator_ffe432bc1a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ffe432bc1a.tts_text: before I close this. I don't close a trailer on a guess.

vo_narrator_9f505439b2.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9f505439b2.tts_text: The trailer door is shut. The seal snaps: NUMBER 88120. The clock in Hollis's head says 11:58. His scanner says 11:59.

vo_narrator_b72b90d180.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b72b90d180.tts_text: Rufus swings T-9022 out of Door 3, across the apron, toward the gate. Torvald, on the dock, is already walking off. Tucker waves after the trailer with both arms. It disappears around the corner of the building.

vo_gordon_820a5a3b73.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_820a5a3b73.tts_text: THE HOT SHIPMENT IS OUT. HOLLIS. IT'S 11:59. I HAVE NEVER BEEN SO HAPPY TO HEAR A TRAILER.

vo_halvorsen_fcba5ff068.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_fcba5ff068.tts_text: It... it left on time. I'm going to go sit down. On the floor. For a minute.

vo_narrator_7b20911cbd.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7b20911cbd.tts_text: Hollis believes the crisis is over.

vo_narrator_9649a03aa9.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9649a03aa9.tts_text: Eight loads shipped. Eight loads stored. The staging lanes are empty. The scanners agree with the racks. The manifest balances.

vo_narrator_a99c3284ce.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a99c3284ce.tts_text: Row C, where the trailers sleep. The WMS says row C is empty and has been since Monday. There are five trailers in it, and a small tabby on each.

vo_narrator_9b32778fc9.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9b32778fc9.tts_text: There it is: T-9022, the hot trailer, parked behind the building, exactly where Rufus's map says it is and exactly where the computer says it is not.

vo_narrator_322e688cf1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_322e688cf1.tts_text: Trailer 31, at the yard gate. It is full of cats, all of them asleep, most of them on the pink blanket. Renata's van is parked beside it. It is the calmest place on the property.

vo_narrator_45f862fbde.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_45f862fbde.tts_text: Trailer 31, set at the yard gate. Empty, heated, with a loading ramp. Not much of a home yet. The interior is wide open and welcoming.

vo_narrator_7393e83ac0.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7393e83ac0.tts_text: Trailer 31, set at the yard gate. Heated, with a loading ramp. It is starting to look like somewhere a cat would choose.

vo_narrator_92344a70bb.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_92344a70bb.tts_text: Trailer 31, empty again except for the pink blanket and three licked-clean bowls. Renata's vans took everyone. It still smells faintly of fish and gratitude.

vo_narrator_b253376e1f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b253376e1f.tts_text: It has bowls and bedding. It is, actually, kind of nice.

vo_narrator_24fedeaf76.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_24fedeaf76.tts_text: The blanket is already there. It looks luxurious.

vo_narrator_28e21ef7e4.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_28e21ef7e4.tts_text: The bowls are already in place.

vo_narrator_2ee21bb039.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_2ee21bb039.tts_text: Hollis sets three bowls inside the trailer and fills them with a little of the good kibble. It looks intentional. It looks like a plan.

vo_narrator_3339deee5a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3339deee5a.tts_text: There's enough kibble in there to make a cat cry with joy.

vo_narrator_c3e9ed77f1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c3e9ed77f1.tts_text: Hollis spreads the pink blanket on the trailer floor. The trailer looks, for the first time in its life, like it has a purpose beyond the transportation of cargo.

vo_narrator_eefc8525e4.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_eefc8525e4.tts_text: Hollis sprinkles some kibble at the far end of the trailer. Far-end kibble: the oldest trick in the book.

vo_narrator_f02d733108.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f02d733108.tts_text: Hollis needs all three of the bowls for this. There should be one in the break room, one on the floor, and one in staging.

vo_scanner_63238878b7.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_63238878b7.tts_text: TRAILER 31 — Status: EMPTY, 214 cats transferred to Whisker Ridge. Bedding: 1 pink blanket. Bowls: licked clean.

vo_narrator_81552f44b2.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_81552f44b2.tts_text: Hollis lays a kibble line from the dock door toward the yard gate.

vo_rufus_0a60d28e64.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_0a60d28e64.tts_text: Cats. I started counting trailers this morning, and I got to the cats. Now I can't stop.

vo_rufus_2c9e8e35a1.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_2c9e8e35a1.tts_text: 141... 142... don't talk to me for a second. 143.

vo_rufus_42a6abe903.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_42a6abe903.tts_text: I know where every trailer is. Every single one. But I can't tell you without my clicker. Lost it Thursday. I'm off count without it.

vo_rufus_452a79d448.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_452a79d448.tts_text: Row C, spot 9. Out past the fuel island. When you need it at the dock, radio me from the outbound dock. I need eyes at the door: a spotter to tell me when it's clear.

vo_rufus_ce94acc78a.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_ce94acc78a.tts_text: It's gone. 11:59. I drove it to the gate myself. That's one trailer I don't have to count.

vo_rufus_d9f3610ee9.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_d9f3610ee9.tts_text: It's at door 3. I put it there. Don't let anybody move it.

vo_rufus_e6a761e8cd.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_e6a761e8cd.tts_text: The WMS says 12 trailers in the yard. I see 41. The WMS is very optimistic about emptiness.

vo_narrator_3bf8994c41.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3bf8994c41.tts_text: A roar of diesel, a hiss of brakes, and Rufus drops Trailer 31 at the yard gate, ramp down, door wide.

vo_rufus_87d4a1451d.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_87d4a1451d.tts_text: Trailer 31? The empty, heated one? For the cats?

vo_rufus_c62414a92b.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_c62414a92b.tts_text: I've been hoping somebody would do something with it.

vo_rufus_dd467a4ffb.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_dd467a4ffb.tts_text: I'd love to. Just as soon as you find my clicker.

vo_rufus_590b61b5f6.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_590b61b5f6.tts_text: If you can count them, tell me the number. Nobody's been able to.

vo_rufus_b6a09db1f2.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_b6a09db1f2.tts_text: 143. 147. Wait. 152. I was counting the same orange one.

vo_narrator_c71aca86c1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c71aca86c1.tts_text: A stack of pallets and a parked forklift, leaning against each other like old friends. Someone has cleared a small, cozy gap between them. Management has checked here twice.

vo_narrator_d08bb73640.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d08bb73640.tts_text: A row of cardboard cat shelters, lined with old towels and one very organized blanket system. Each has a name on it in marker: SGT. BISCUIT, THE PROFESSOR, LITTLE TUCKER, BIG TORVALD. Someone has put real effort into this.

vo_narrator_1580dd605c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1580dd605c.tts_text: Hollis fishes a quarter out of the frame with a fingernail. A cat watches him with what looks like professional curiosity.

vo_narrator_262153a442.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_262153a442.tts_text: There is a quarter lodged in the grate's frame.

vo_narrator_6f59b5922c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6f59b5922c.tts_text: A storm grate. From below, a soft chorus of meows echoes upward. It is oddly musical.

vo_narrator_99e9dcc76f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_99e9dcc76f.tts_text: Nothing else but cold water and moral complications.

vo_prudence_2e09e9a78b.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_2e09e9a78b.tts_text: Oh, put it down, please. I would rather not be technically in possession. I don't want to be technically in possession.

vo_gus_51ce81abd4.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_51ce81abd4.tts_text: It's beautiful. It's also not a Regional badge. I can't let you up. Rules.

vo_gus_8dad8ce878.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_8dad8ce878.tts_text: ...I'm not saying anything about Conveyor 9. I didn't say anything about Conveyor 9.

vo_gus_c49e000737.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_c49e000737.tts_text: I can't accept things. Regional rules.

vo_gus_f85bdc7ab0.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_f85bdc7ab0.tts_text: An HR Exemption 9-M? For Non-Standard Breath?

vo_narrator_0aece5e494.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0aece5e494.tts_text: Gus glances at the corridor, then at the ceiling, then at a security monitor showing Rack 14.

vo_narrator_4d31c55c31.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4d31c55c31.tts_text: The reader stays red. Gus doesn't move. The only other way in is not through Gus.

vo_harrow_c483dcb0d6.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_c483dcb0d6.tts_text: I don't take deliverables from the floor. Send them through the proper channel. There is no proper channel.

vo_scanner_76b3db342e.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_76b3db342e.tts_text: Attempting to scan a person as a metric... Result: 100.0%. Confidence: 100.0%. Note: this device is now on a Performance Improvement Plan.

vo_scanner_e012518ab5.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_e012518ab5.tts_text: CONSTANCE HARROW — Regional Director. Reading... reading...

vo_narrator_08aa88ee63.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_08aa88ee63.tts_text: There is no leaving during a Regional Review. It is in the calendar.

vo_narrator_aa52d7a248.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_aa52d7a248.tts_text: There is no leaving during a Regional Review.

vo_narrator_d95ced64f7.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d95ced64f7.tts_text: The trailer backs six feet, corrects itself, and returns to the yard with dignity.

vo_narrator_aa29398460.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_aa29398460.tts_text: T-9022 eases into Door 3. The dock plate falls with a satisfying clang. The light is green. The computer, for the first time in a week, is correct. It has no idea why.

vo_rufus_d1ad975e0d.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_d1ad975e0d.tts_text: GO. Backing in. Torvald, call it.

vo_torvald_e18398fd6e.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_e18398fd6e.tts_text: ...Come on back. Come back. Keep coming. Aaand STOP.

vo_narrator_e1c2cdf3fa.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e1c2cdf3fa.tts_text: The dashboard redefines a metric while Hollis hesitates. Reality frays at the edges.

vo_narrator_f00868b287.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f00868b287.tts_text: HALO rewrites the records faster than Hollis can read. The numbers reset. He inhales. He tries again.

vo_harrow_bb21108ab1.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_bb21108ab1.tts_text: This is a Regional Operational Review. I'd like to begin by saying: everything is functioning at a hundred percent. The dashboard tells me so. I would ask you to demonstrate otherwise. Take your time. Not too much.

vo_harrow_fc3e1b623f.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_fc3e1b623f.tts_text: You came through the server closet.

vo_narrator_85433e264a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_85433e264a.tts_text: Constance Harrow stands at the head of the conference table, tablet in hand. Behind her, the HALO wall shines with a serene, perfect, all-green light. Juno sits beside Hollis. Juno's armband glows faintly.

vo_narrator_38c48bdbb5.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_38c48bdbb5.tts_text: The suite hums. Somewhere, a fan starts.

vo_narrator_d9504a57b2.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d9504a57b2.tts_text: The walls of the suite begin to shudder. Labels flutter down from the ceiling. The HALO wall reassigns something with a tiny, cheerful ding.

vo_harrow_377f253eb0.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_377f253eb0.tts_text: The dashboard is never wrong. That's the whole point of the dashboard. If it's wrong, then everything it has reported —

vo_harrow_a309c2b979.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_a309c2b979.tts_text: ...The dashboard says the numbers have not changed.

vo_harrow_558a0fdf1d.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_558a0fdf1d.tts_text: HALO. Initiate Regional Operational Review, live mode. Reconcile all site data to Regional targets.

vo_halvorsen_55e076e188.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_55e076e188.tts_text: STOP! DON'T MOVE! MOVE EVERYTHING! I'm not loading that! I've lost count! CAN I HELP?

vo_harrow_8d6cd17045.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_8d6cd17045.tts_text: The system is now ensuring that reality matches its projections.

vo_hollis_32caebb537.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_32caebb537.tts_text: It's going to rewrite the building.

vo_narrator_7fa0996eef.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7fa0996eef.tts_text: The HALO wall lights up like a slot machine. KPIs cascade across the screen. Trailer assignments rewrite themselves. Labels print uncontrollably from the ceiling vents. The scanner in Hollis's pocket beeps eleven times and rewrites its own logs. Staging lanes, somewhere below, reassign themselves. On the radio, three contradictory instructions arrive at once.

vo_narrator_e52221202e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e52221202e.tts_text: Cats appear on the conference table. On the HALO wall. On Harrow's tablet. One sits on the "SUBMIT" button.

vo_narrator_77def68b66.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_77def68b66.tts_text: Hollis has one more resource. A second mint? No. He has a mint's worth of faith in the world being solid. The glow inside him climbs past what the mint was ever meant to hold.

vo_narrator_d6f554200d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d6f554200d.tts_text: Hollis perceives every pallet. Every trailer. Every serial number. Every destination. Every staging lane. Every production order. Every scanner record. Every misplaced forklift. Every missing manifest. Every cat: all two hundred and fourteen, plus the few who chose to stay.

vo_narrator_e4b6b21d67.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e4b6b21d67.tts_text: It runs through him like a river of freight. For a few seconds, he understands the entire supply chain. It is enormous. It is stupid. It is beautiful.

vo_narrator_1ba2a5065b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1ba2a5065b.tts_text: The HALO wall floods with records, true and false.

vo_narrator_96a2f36bd0.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_96a2f36bd0.tts_text: The false records strike red and vanish, one by one. The true records glow green and settle back into place. The suite goes very quiet.

vo_narrator_6bf8c80eb5.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6bf8c80eb5.tts_text: Hollis turns to the HALO terminal at the side of the table. There is a login. He has a password from somebody who technically doesn't work here, and a crumpled label that has been in his pocket since 9:02.

vo_narrator_cf8fee74d9.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cf8fee74d9.tts_text: Hollis remembers he has a bigger task, and puts the scanner away.

vo_harrow_edd1a6bf25.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_edd1a6bf25.tts_text: Whatever you are about to do, Hollis, do it.

vo_narrator_b8db9c6e4f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b8db9c6e4f.tts_text: The terminal waits. Harrow waits. A cat on the table waits, with the most patience.

vo_narrator_7962277500.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7962277500.tts_text: ACCESS DENIED. Hollis has no password for this terminal.

vo_hollis_930bb4bff4.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_930bb4bff4.tts_text: Template 000. Tucker printed it by accident. It's the only record HALO never rewrote.

vo_narrator_647ea6eefa.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_647ea6eefa.tts_text: Hollis hesitates. The wall still says 100% about everything. Harrow is watching the wall, not him.

vo_narrator_6ba9c36431.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6ba9c36431.tts_text: The prompt keeps blinking. The dashboard behind it is still lying. Nothing is fixed until the label goes in.

vo_narrator_44231da513.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_44231da513.tts_text: The cats sit down. The labels stop. The suite's lights stop flickering.

vo_narrator_656b9de08d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_656b9de08d.tts_text: The dashboard begins to change. 100% becomes 8 of 8 shipped. 100% becomes 8 of 8 stored. Staging: 0. Cats: 214, fed, safe, judgmental. T-9022: departed 11:59. F-2231: cushion-tire, here. RT-77: reach truck, remote. Every number is small, specific, and true.

vo_narrator_8f900bf3f1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8f900bf3f1.tts_text: Hollis pats his pockets. He has nothing the optic reader would recognise as ground truth.

vo_harrow_328d628688.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_328d628688.tts_text: I'm suspending Directive 7-C, the Metric Harmonization Initiative, and the automatic approvals. Physical verification will be a standing line item. Someone will have to do it.

vo_harrow_944c0d360f.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_944c0d360f.tts_text: ...Physical inventory match: 100%. Physical. Not projected. It's the first time in two years the dashboard and the warehouse have agreed.

vo_harrow_fec99232b1.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_fec99232b1.tts_text: I was managing numbers. I thought the numbers were the warehouse.

vo_hollis_9b9d2bf8b1.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_9b9d2bf8b1.tts_text: The warehouse never stopped being right. It was just underreported.

vo_narrator_936ec65635.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_936ec65635.tts_text: She glances at Hollis. Hollis glances at the door.

vo_gordon_4e0705cb8f.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_4e0705cb8f.tts_text: What does that mean, in shipping language?

vo_gordon_76f22c4e53.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_76f22c4e53.tts_text: Hollis! Gordon, Kestrel Motor Works, production manager. Your customer. Finally. Are we shipping? Line three has been down since 7. I have forty guys standing around holding air.

vo_hollis_279f1c5c04.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_279f1c5c04.tts_text: The system says the trailer is at Door 3.

vo_hollis_2e74fa71d6.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_2e74fa71d6.tts_text: In the yard, Row C. The computer doesn't know that yet.

vo_gordon_c4f26e3dd1.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_c4f26e3dd1.tts_text: Okay. Okay. What do you need from me?

vo_gordon_76f41ea6ff.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_76f41ea6ff.tts_text: We don't even sell those. Why would I want a reach truck?

vo_gordon_e887c77f5f.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_e887c77f5f.tts_text: Fine. Here's what we ordered. PO 55-1187. Cushion-tire forklifts ×2. Mast assembly. Overhead guard. 48-volt battery. Hydraulic hose kit. Control harness crate. Counterweight blocks. Eight lines. That's it. I don't care about anything else.

vo_gordon_6944bb35ab.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_6944bb35ab.tts_text: The system also has our Ohio freight going to Tennessee, apparently. That's not a labeling problem, that's a sickness.

vo_gordon_a1a5e646b2.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_a1a5e646b2.tts_text: That serial is a cushion-tire, CT-2231. Same model as the two on our order, CT-118 and CT-119, but it is not one of ours. Not propane, either. Whatever your system says.

vo_hollis_76a021b036.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_76a021b036.tts_text: I'm sending you the scan of a forklift. Serial CT-2231. Tell me what you see.

vo_narrator_c86bdce69f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c86bdce69f.tts_text: guys are standing around holding air. I have started to give the air names.

vo_gordon_ce6a5dcfdd.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_ce6a5dcfdd.tts_text: Cushion-tire forklift ×2. Mast assembly. Overhead guard. 48V battery. Hose kit. Harness crate. Counterweights. That's all eight. Nothing else ships.

vo_gordon_c663c5271e.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_c663c5271e.tts_text: Two forklifts. Mast. Guard. Battery. Hose. Harness. Counterweights. [pause] That's right. That is exactly right. That is... Hollis, that's the first correct shipment we've had in three weeks.

vo_hollis_0e5fa94330.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_0e5fa94330.tts_text: Gordon. I've loaded the eight. Can you confirm the list against your production requirements?

vo_gordon_ceca8a8493.speaker: GORDON
vo_gordon_ceca8a8493.tts_text: Line three needs the mast, the battery, and the guard first. If they land by 2, we're running by 3.

vo_ozzie_32dcf69495.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_32dcf69495.tts_text: There's a reach truck in my yard. The WMS says it's a cushion-tire called RT-77. It has a very specific opinion about being a forklift.

vo_ozzie_409a24a575.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_409a24a575.tts_text: Hollis! It's Ozzie, remote site. That is the little overflow yard we lease, two hundred miles from anything. What do you need?

vo_ozzie_3775c6335b.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_3775c6335b.tts_text: Cold. Empty. One reach truck. One radio. I have a sandwich. The site is very... quiet. The kind of quiet where you can hear a system being wrong.

vo_ozzie_9dab37f31a.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_9dab37f31a.tts_text: Cats? No. A crow. It has been standing on the reach truck since Friday. I would say it is management-adjacent.

vo_ozzie_b2139fe401.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_b2139fe401.tts_text: Still none. A crow looked at the reach truck for a while. I think it was auditing.

vo_ozzie_662e72baae.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_662e72baae.tts_text: Thank you. I check it every hour.

vo_ozzie_d10806fe54.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_d10806fe54.tts_text: It is turkey. It is the only thing at this site with a confirmed location.

vo_hollis_652d10908d.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_652d10908d.tts_text: And here, the cushion-tire on my floor is listed as a propane sit-down in Tennessee. Your reach truck got my forklift's paperwork, and my forklift got somebody's Tennessee order.

vo_hollis_97aa5488f1.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_97aa5488f1.tts_text: The WMS says RT-77 is a cushion-tire forklift.

vo_hollis_c80ff5480e.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_c80ff5480e.tts_text: The system thinks two machines are each other. Plus Tennessee.

vo_ozzie_80bc736387.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_80bc736387.tts_text: Okay. I'm at the machine. It's blue. It's tall. It has forks that go up. The plate says... RT-77. REACH TRUCK. Serial RT-0077. Yes.

vo_ozzie_a5b9e44f12.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_a5b9e44f12.tts_text: So the computer mixed them up.

vo_ozzie_d96568c86e.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_d96568c86e.tts_text: The WMS is wrong. This is not a cushion-tire. This is an RT-anything.

vo_ozzie_ac24dba182.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_ac24dba182.tts_text: Sure. What do I check? [pause] Hollis, I can't check something I don't know to look for. What does your side say?

vo_hollis_3889d6fe75.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_3889d6fe75.tts_text: Ozzie, I've fixed the identity swap. Can you check the remote site's freight against the corrected records?

vo_ozzie_c62dcbda5e.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_c62dcbda5e.tts_text: RT-77: REACH TRUCK. REMOTE SITE. Confirmed. Nothing else here. Nothing missing. Nothing extra. It's the most boring inventory I've ever done and I love it.

vo_renata_7ee802033c.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_7ee802033c.tts_text: Still coming. I'll be at the yard gate when you're ready. Text me when they're moving. Or don't. I'll know.

vo_hollis_03e9d137a9.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_03e9d137a9.tts_text: I scanned them. The scanner had a breakdown.

vo_hollis_fc51ff7082.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_fc51ff7082.tts_text: I have a... situation. Cats. In a warehouse.

vo_renata_37948788ce.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_37948788ce.tts_text: Okay. Where are they living? What are they eating? And is there a safe place we can take them?

vo_renata_208c4909c8.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_208c4909c8.tts_text: Call me when you know why they're there. If we can't fix the source, they'll come back. I can take them. But the pallet has to go.

vo_hollis_a5a2866264.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_a5a2866264.tts_text: There's a mislabeled pallet of bulk kibble. Cats from a colony by the drain came in through a dock door. If you can spare a trailer at the yard gate, I can put bowls and a blanket in it.

vo_renata_58d26e0ff6.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_58d26e0ff6.tts_text: That works. We'll bring vans. Get them fed and calm and moving in a line. Put kibble along the route. Have someone they trust call the leader. I'll be at the gate.

vo_narrator_08b26529c5.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_08b26529c5.tts_text: Hollis needs to pick something to give first.

vo_narrator_2b7e89ab31.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_2b7e89ab31.tts_text: has nothing to say to Hollis right now.

vo_narrator_e4025748cc.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e4025748cc.tts_text: The barcode is blurry and, oddly, not in any format Hollis recognizes.

vo_narrator_6d3b10de66.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6d3b10de66.tts_text: It does not power on. The battery compartment is empty.

vo_narrator_a45b576665.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a45b576665.tts_text: It is the only document in the building that says what is actually on the trucks.

vo_narrator_4d236e4f11.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4d236e4f11.tts_text: Hollis raises his scanner. It is dead. It has the vibe of a person who was not told the meeting was moved.

vo_narrator_dec006e331.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_dec006e331.tts_text: Hollis has no scanner. He also has no idea where his radio is. It has been a morning.

vo_system_a7b5a6d676.speaker: SYSTEM
vo_system_a7b5a6d676.tts_text: The label's barcode resolves: "TEMPLATE 000 — HALO GROUND TRUTH REFERENCE — ADMIN".

vo_scanner_38bcd559cb.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_38bcd559cb.tts_text: PALLET JACK — Mass: 190 lb. Volume: pocket. Inventory violations: 1, accepted.

vo_narrator_7ed0328dfb.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7ed0328dfb.tts_text: It is, in fact, 9:02 only in the break room.

vo_narrator_f6d2e6aabe.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f6d2e6aabe.tts_text: Hollis pops the battery into the scanner. The screen flickers, reboots, and displays: "GOOD MORNING, HOLLIS. IT IS 9:02."

vo_narrator_421187b812.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_421187b812.tts_text: Hollis considers refilling the bowls. He does not. That is how this started.

vo_narrator_5cb441b3ba.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5cb441b3ba.tts_text: Blanket + kibble: a pillow fort for cats. That's a good idea. Save it for later.

vo_scanner_d8806577e8.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_d8806577e8.tts_text: Mint unscannable. Contents: unauthorized. Please do not put the scanner in your mouth either.

vo_narrator_b94c27c118.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b94c27c118.tts_text: Hollis looks at both items and, correctly, does nothing.

vo_narrator_cdac9bb9b0.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cdac9bb9b0.tts_text: Those two do not go together. Hollis checks the manual in his head. It is empty.

vo_narrator_f172a69d9a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f172a69d9a.tts_text: The inventory has rules. That is not one of them.

vo_narrator_97dd281f21.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_97dd281f21.tts_text: It is already in Hollis's pocket, which is a mildly disturbing thing to say.

vo_narrator_d76dc788b4.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d76dc788b4.tts_text: Juno sniffs the inventory panel. Hollis is not sure how she did that.

vo_narrator_6dcc671d65.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6dcc671d65.tts_text: Juno: medium-sized, alert, mostly black with white paws and a very tan opinion about everything. She is looking back at you with the patience of a coworker who has been carrying the team for years.

vo_narrator_669ad20b20.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_669ad20b20.tts_text: Juno sits. She has thoughts about the warehouse. They are mostly correct.

vo_scanner_35ef262e75.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_35ef262e75.tts_text: JUNO — Type: DOG, GOOD. Location: WITH HOLLIS. Competence: exceeds several employees. Barcode: none. Warning: this asset is not for sale.

vo_narrator_24e2e5920b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_24e2e5920b.tts_text: Juno does not do that. She does other things.

vo_narrator_554b150bdc.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_554b150bdc.tts_text: Hollis checks Juno's mouth. She has a stick in it. Nobody knows where she got it.

vo_narrator_0c54b4d29d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0c54b4d29d.tts_text: SAFETY COMMITTEE — MEMBER, TEMP. Juno stands a little taller. Somewhere in the warehouse, two hundred cats collectively feel a chill.

vo_narrator_32662e3af9.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_32662e3af9.tts_text: Hollis slides the green armband over Juno's foreleg. She holds still with professional dignity.

vo_narrator_7f134e2c06.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7f134e2c06.tts_text: Juno looks at the kibble. Then at Hollis. Then pointedly at the door. She is a professional.

vo_narrator_4c76a5271b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4c76a5271b.tts_text: Juno sniffs the fish crackers and turns her head away. Whatever they are, it's not a dog snack, and she knows it.

vo_narrator_71ad51ed73.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_71ad51ed73.tts_text: Juno sniffs it politely and looks at Hollis. It is not that.

vo_narrator_0010c718b6.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0010c718b6.tts_text: This is Building 9 of the Gantry-Voss Logistics distribution center. Hollis is the shift lead here: he scans freight in, scans freight out, and is blamed in both directions.

vo_narrator_9697a351af.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9697a351af.tts_text: The fluorescent lights buzz at a frequency Hollis associates with mistakes.

vo_narrator_e7185f3f5e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e7185f3f5e.tts_text: Hollis wakes up at a break-room table. He does not remember falling asleep.

vo_narrator_954f71a199.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_954f71a199.tts_text: The clock on the wall says 9:02. The clock has said 9:02 for as long as anyone can remember, so this is not information.

vo_narrator_ce2731eb4a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ce2731eb4a.tts_text: His radio is missing. His handheld scanner, the thing that tells the warehouse computer where every pallet is is dead. Someone has taken the last decent coffee. There is a crumpled shipping label stuck to his boot.

vo_narrator_433b6392d8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_433b6392d8.tts_text: On top of the vending machine, a cat sits looking at him. Nobody acknowledges this. Nobody is here. This is a warehouse. There are not supposed to be cats.

vo_narrator_bf84f6964c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_bf84f6964c.tts_text: Through the door, faintly, reverse beepers and alarms. Somewhere, a forklift has an opinion.

vo_narrator_209a1eb088.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_209a1eb088.tts_text: Today's job, such as it is: find out what everyone is so upset about, and get the scanner working so Hollis can check.

vo_narrator_c0a80ef2c1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c0a80ef2c1.tts_text: It is a Tuesday. It is humid. It is going to get worse.

vo_narrator_f48d8bbf9b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f48d8bbf9b.tts_text: Juno trots over. She has the expression of a dog who tried to wake him twice and has decided to be gracious about it.

vo_narrator_0b74ed92ef.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0b74ed92ef.tts_text: Hollis has operated enough equipment without authorization today.

vo_narrator_c803a9fc5c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c803a9fc5c.tts_text: An exit. Hollis has used it before.

vo_narrator_0f691bff3c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0f691bff3c.tts_text: Hollis has a vague sense he should read the records before rewriting them. That is the kind of discipline that comes with experience.

vo_narrator_74bf6aa5c2.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_74bf6aa5c2.tts_text: The terminal already agrees with reality. It seems to be holding its breath.

vo_narrator_cc1a9f7e64.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cc1a9f7e64.tts_text: Hollis has the serials from Tucker's notebook, but the system's claim about the remote site should be confirmed by someone standing next to that reach truck. Ozzie, maybe.

vo_narrator_58946b54cf.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_58946b54cf.tts_text: Hollis logs in as admin. He opens the identity table. RT-77 is carrying F-2231's cushion-tire spec, and F-2231 has been handed a propane spec and a Tennessee address off Directive 7-C. Tucker's notebook has the original plates and serials for both.

vo_narrator_05708a951e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_05708a951e.tts_text: Somewhere, two pieces of equipment are handed back the personalities they had all along.

vo_system_6a17e5be7a.speaker: SYSTEM
vo_system_6a17e5be7a.tts_text: Identities restored. F-2231: CUSHION-TIRE, HERE. RT-77: REACH TRUCK, REMOTE SITE.

vo_narrator_ed3cea9d41.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ed3cea9d41.tts_text: Hollis works the padlock free. The cage door swings open. A dozen cats stream out past Tucker like commuters.

vo_tucker_7d33e70e89.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_7d33e70e89.tts_text: Hollis! You saved me! I'd have been in there until lunch. Or Wednesday.

vo_tucker_656dce1a73.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_656dce1a73.tts_text: Oh — wait. Here. I always write serial numbers down when I move stuff. It's a thing I do. Nobody's ever asked for it before.

vo_hollis_f59d3d6800.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_f59d3d6800.tts_text: Reach trucks. Marked for Nebraska. The manifest said Tennessee.

vo_narrator_0e9939347c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0e9939347c.tts_text: Nothing on the Kestrel order matches this.

vo_narrator_c3d45e88cb.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c3d45e88cb.tts_text: Something on the Kestrel order matches this.

vo_narrator_347a9bc23e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_347a9bc23e.tts_text: Hollis needs a pallet jack for this. Something that doesn't leak hydraulic fluid on his boots. Ideally Bruno's.

vo_narrator_e8027648ca.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e8027648ca.tts_text: The pallet jack disagrees. The pallet jack has a chip in it.

vo_bruno_4fbc82c5da.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_4fbc82c5da.tts_text: I don't load pallets with a cat on it. Or twelve. I have a policy.

vo_narrator_1a4fce7c08.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1a4fce7c08.tts_text: Twelve cats are sleeping on it.

vo_narrator_f805e583c9.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f805e583c9.tts_text: The policy is his own. It is sound.

vo_narrator_34e463e110.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_34e463e110.tts_text: Hollis brings it back to its lane, as though nothing happened. Three minutes of the morning are gone.

vo_narrator_b4caa7fc1a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b4caa7fc1a.tts_text: Hollis starts to move it. Two seconds later the jack pulls hard to one side and a small chorus of forklift horns delivers a verdict.

vo_narrator_a3e458a172.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a3e458a172.tts_text: Before it goes, Hollis slits the wrap and scoops some kibble into a tote lid. This pallet is not a counterweight, and the cats will need a trail.

vo_narrator_3ae1780530.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3ae1780530.tts_text: The last pallet leaves the lane. The staging lanes are empty. Every line is painted concrete. It is beautiful.

vo_narrator_de9fc6ae57.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_de9fc6ae57.tts_text: Eight loads to the outbound dock. Eight loads to storage. Nothing duplicated. Nothing missing. Somewhere, a spreadsheet feels seen.

vo_system_5b443afe90.speaker: SYSTEM
vo_system_5b443afe90.tts_text: a warm, tall, cigarette-shaped heat signature resolves into Torvald, who is standing exactly where he was standing.

vo_narrator_8a487bd994.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8a487bd994.tts_text: Juno has already found Torvald this round. She looks smug about it.

vo_narrator_2373debf93.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_2373debf93.tts_text: Juno sniffs around, but doesn't know who Hollis wants. She needs a scent: something Torvald wore or touched.

vo_narrator_1829c04c0b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1829c04c0b.tts_text: Juno freezes, points her nose at a spot that looks entirely like nothing, and barks twice.

vo_narrator_3636f7c664.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3636f7c664.tts_text: The jack is fixed. It hisses only in contentment.

vo_narrator_8ddcdba8b3.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8ddcdba8b3.tts_text: Hollis holds up the hydraulic seal kit. Bruno's eyes go wide, then narrow, then wide.

vo_bruno_925d25b0b1.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_925d25b0b1.tts_text: Is that an H-17? Where did you find that? I've been asking Parts for that seal since March. Nobody's in Parts. Who let you into Parts?

vo_bruno_ce36aa34a5.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_ce36aa34a5.tts_text: Don't tell me. Actually, do tell me.

vo_narrator_f597d3c44a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f597d3c44a.tts_text: Bruno drops to a knee and works the seal into the jack. It fizzes, then hums. The jack rises. It lowers. It rises again. The puddle stops.

vo_bruno_d0b19a18e2.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_d0b19a18e2.tts_text: She's alive. Here — keep it. You'll need it more than me. I've got another one, older, meaner. As for my dots — you were wondering, right?

vo_bruno_6db3c470b5.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_6db3c470b5.tts_text: Orange dot: goes on my truck. Blue dot: stays inside. No dot: I never touched it, usually because there was a cat on it, or I didn't like the look of the label.

vo_narrator_63cccc0599.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_63cccc0599.tts_text: The scanner reboots itself. It seems to need a moment.

vo_scanner_22a4d71582.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_22a4d71582.tts_text: RECOUNTING... ERROR. THE CATS HAVE MOVED.

vo_scanner_a68c705efa.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_a68c705efa.tts_text: CAT — Asset tag: NONE. Purr rate: 26 Hz. Reliability: 3%.

vo_narrator_13e5daa61d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_13e5daa61d.tts_text: Hollis reaches for a cat. Three other cats move into the space where the cat was. He has a sense that he is being managed.

vo_narrator_58b1060b7d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_58b1060b7d.tts_text: Hollis reaches for the cat. The cat has a look. Hollis withdraws his hand with the speed of a man who has heard about cats.

vo_narrator_bbba80e36a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_bbba80e36a.tts_text: Hollis reaches for the cat. It sits down harder. Hollis lets it stay.

vo_narrator_7ac8d66403.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7ac8d66403.tts_text: The cat becomes very heavy, then very liquid. Hollis decides to leave it exactly where it is.

vo_narrator_1bff2ac8c8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1bff2ac8c8.tts_text: Hollis does not know how you open a cat. He has no wish to learn.

vo_narrator_fa1e234da0.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fa1e234da0.tts_text: Hollis considers calling for the cat. The cat has been here longer than the phone system. It ignores him on principle.

vo_narrator_933f191b90.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_933f191b90.tts_text: The cat considers it, and Hollis, and declines both.

vo_narrator_cf985c1c56.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cf985c1c56.tts_text: The cat does not want that.

vo_narrator_41342cdc35.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_41342cdc35.tts_text: There are no cats here. Juno is unsettled by the emptiness.

vo_hollis_2fced595ca.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_2fced595ca.tts_text: They don't think she's in charge.

vo_narrator_0991b73c24.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0991b73c24.tts_text: Juno barks at the cats. The cats look at her the way a crowd looks at a substitute teacher. Not a single one moves. One yawns. A tabby begins to bathe.

vo_narrator_595937580d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_595937580d.tts_text: Juno barks. The cats sit up. Several look at her armband. One salutes, in a cat way, by not doing anything. But there is nothing yet for the cats to move toward. She needs a plan behind her.

vo_narrator_3e6e2b190f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3e6e2b190f.tts_text: Juno looks around at the cats here, then at Hollis. This is not the place. The main warehouse floor would be the place for a crowd this size.

vo_narrator_b243973c34.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b243973c34.tts_text: What follows is, without exaggeration, the most organized thing to happen in this warehouse in a decade.

vo_narrator_b9eb41668b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b9eb41668b.tts_text: Juno steps forward. The armband gleams. The floor goes quiet.

vo_narrator_91b15a72d6.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_91b15a72d6.tts_text: Tucker, at the outbound door, is holding it open with both arms and his whole heart. Not a single cat passes through incorrectly.

vo_narrator_cdf5379524.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cdf5379524.tts_text: Juno trots at the head of the column, tail high, armband green. The whole colony walks in single file toward Trailer 31 like a very slow, very polite parade.

vo_narrator_27320e3e29.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_27320e3e29.tts_text: Juno returns, alone, a little smug. Behind her, on the floor, a few last cats remain: the office regulars, the ones who have been employed longer than some employees.

vo_narrator_6afbf72830.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6afbf72830.tts_text: The warehouse is, for the first time this morning, almost quiet.

vo_halvorsen_4b4318d450.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_4b4318d450.tts_text: There's no cat problem, I'm told. Please disregard the cat on the forklift.

vo_narrator_9f5dcc5235.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9f5dcc5235.tts_text: Between one hallway and the next, the cats multiply. It is like a rumor that got legs. Dozens are on the racks. Dozens are in the office. A cat is sitting in a forklift seat, looking like it is doing the job of two employees.

vo_narrator_3f792557cd.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3f792557cd.tts_text: From the break room, faintly, comes a THUNK. The vending machine. Something in slot D4 is blinking. Hollis has a feeling about it.

vo_radio_45d08f4b1a.speaker: RADIO
vo_radio_45d08f4b1a.tts_text: Hollis, Operations. HR just called. Your mandatory drug screening is scheduled for 9:02. It is now— [long pause] — it's always 9:02 in HR. Report to HR immediately.

vo_ingrid_c3b222f546.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_c3b222f546.tts_text: The WMS just released the reconciliation hold on staging. Every pallet is now movable. It's the first thing the WMS has done all week.

vo_narrator_71ff504bba.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_71ff504bba.tts_text: The rule for the pallets: ship the eight that match Kestrel's purchase order, store the other eight, and leave staging empty.

vo_narrator_9467dd2007.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9467dd2007.tts_text: There is a hot trailer to find, sixteen pallets to sort, a cat parade to organize, and a Regional review that hasn't noticed yet. Also, coffee.

vo_narrator_fa58fdda97.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fa58fdda97.tts_text: One more thing the WMS wants to mention: the hot trailer, T-9022, is on a compliance hold. Somebody will have to clear it before it can come to a dock door.

vo_hollis_56d81c31f4.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_56d81c31f4.tts_text: I woke up in the break room.

vo_radio_79ee59db9b.speaker: RADIO
vo_radio_79ee59db9b.tts_text: Why. [pause] I don't need to know. The system says everything is ready. Go verify it. Start on the main floor and scan something. Scan the forklift. Tucker, the new inbound guy, says it is fine, which is the problem. Ingrid, our shipping clerk, has the paperwork. She will tell you she does not. Bruno, lead loader and unofficial mechanic, has the forklifts. Rufus in the yard has the trailers. Torvald was supposed to be spotting them, and nobody has seen him since dawn. He takes his breaks somewhere. Juno could track him if she had something of his to sniff. Someone has the cats.

vo_radio_bd20c42f1c.speaker: RADIO
vo_radio_bd20c42f1c.tts_text: Hollis? It's Halvorsen, Operations Manager. Where are you. We have a HOT shipment. That means a customer is losing money by the minute. Kestrel Motor Works, their assembly line is stalled waiting on parts. Eight loads, out the door by NOON.
