vo_narrator_5f6e1b24b2.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5f6e1b24b2.tts_text: She says it like it is a small fee at a parking garage. Nobody in Security has taken it up. Security is aware she is present. Security has decided this is Operations' problem.

vo_prudence_b85ecf7481.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_b85ecf7481.tts_text: Oh! Hollis. Hi. I was just finishing something. Eleven years in Inventory Control, you know. They never did make a form for my exit.

vo_prudence_022548cf84.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_022548cf84.tts_text: Honestly? Still finishing something. Can't stop now.

vo_prudence_1966c559d1.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_1966c559d1.tts_text: A technicality. Paperwork. The work itself is still happening.

vo_prudence_4c98cdbd0b.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_4c98cdbd0b.tts_text: It was a process. It hasn't concluded.

vo_prudence_bcee717e1f.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_bcee717e1f.tts_text: I'd trade it for something. I have friends who'd appreciate something salty. Fish-shaped, ideally. From that vending machine.

vo_prudence_c0b03bd721.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_c0b03bd721.tts_text: Oh, the coffee? That's mine. I mean, that's communal. That I'm... holding.

vo_prudence_808ed58987.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_808ed58987.tts_text: Never saw this. Bin H-17 has what Bruno needs. He's been asking since March.

vo_prudence_e3f2e1d642.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_e3f2e1d642.tts_text: Parts? Oh, that's locked. It's restricted. Only Parts staff have the key.

vo_prudence_fa63dbb20c.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_fa63dbb20c.tts_text: I don't work anywhere. I am, however, a keyholder in a personal, unofficial capacity.

vo_prudence_8f6a68039c.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_8f6a68039c.tts_text: Cats? What cats. I think you'd have better luck asking someone who's been spending time by the drain.

vo_hollis_86e5832c05.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_86e5832c05.tts_text: Prudence. HALO's admin login. Do you happen to know it?

vo_prudence_84f7f64731.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_84f7f64731.tts_text: Because nobody knows it. Except me. And the tech. And now you. It's unauthorized information. Very unofficial.

vo_hollis_d454674a41.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_d454674a41.tts_text: When the migration starts, will Biscuit follow your voice?

vo_prudence_2a09f9ca99.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_2a09f9ca99.tts_text: Sergeant Biscuit follows exactly one voice. Yes. Tell me when.

vo_hollis_e02ded1645.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_e02ded1645.tts_text: The WMS has T-9022 on a compliance hold. I can't bring it to door 3 without an override.

vo_prudence_be6e731dce.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_be6e731dce.tts_text: Oh, that. It's just a rule with a password that's supposed to belong to Regional.

vo_prudence_ed8bdc9768.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_ed8bdc9768.tts_text: Oh, lovely. But I have already been very well looked after today. Those are for someone else.

vo_narrator_2681e27107.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_2681e27107.tts_text: Hollis offers the fish crackers. Prudence's eyes light up like a smoke detector at a barbecue.

vo_prudence_fd578e1252.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_fd578e1252.tts_text: Oh, you didn't have to. Fine. Here. The last decent coffee. But you didn't get it from me.

vo_narrator_a094d2a63d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a094d2a63d.tts_text: Hollis takes the coffee. It is hot, dark, and almost sentimental.

vo_hollis_069205f718.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_069205f718.tts_text: Prudence. I know about the drain. The shelters. The names.

vo_prudence_a7637c08a0.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_a7637c08a0.tts_text: It started with six. Sergeant Biscuit, the Professor... they've been out by the drain since spring. I was feeding them at dawn. Fired-me had a lot of dawns.

vo_prudence_3290f0d8a8.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_3290f0d8a8.tts_text: Oh, is that what they are? I saw the label say "counterweight", and I thought, that's a funny weight. Then Tucker started putting out bowls. Every place they looked hungry. He was so proud.

vo_prudence_721d50e6ba.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_721d50e6ba.tts_text: Then last Friday, a trailer came in with a torn seal. Door nine got left open. Something in it smelled like a fish market on a good day. The whole colony walked in like it was a buffet.

vo_prudence_5d79b07093.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_5d79b07093.tts_text: He's got a piece of paper on him. Stuck to his fur. From the trailer. He wears it like a medal. He hangs around Rack 14. He'll do anything for a fish cracker.

vo_prudence_c495084846.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_c495084846.tts_text: The cats found the warm building and told their friends. Cats are like that. One colony calls the next colony, and the next.

vo_hollis_79e6bddd13.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_79e6bddd13.tts_text: And when I need him to leave?

vo_prudence_341bfc9596.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_341bfc9596.tts_text: He'll leave for me. Just say when.

vo_hollis_1081082f2a.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_1081082f2a.tts_text: Prudence was in the break room?

vo_tucker_8f29a60608.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_8f29a60608.tts_text: Was she? She's everywhere. Anyway! How can I help? I'm great at helping.

vo_tucker_9236d91136.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_9236d91136.tts_text: HOLLIS! You're awake! I've been so worried! I'm on Inbound, three weeks in, remember? I unload the trailers and put them in the computer! I tried to wake you but Prudence said you needed the sleep.

vo_hollis_70243b4090.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_70243b4090.tts_text: I'm mildly proud of how much I'm not mad.

vo_hollis_75fb4af28f.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_75fb4af28f.tts_text: It's back in my scanner now. Fine.

vo_tucker_858f84e6b3.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_858f84e6b3.tts_text: Oh! The clock kept dying, and I needed a battery that was... shaped like a battery. I found one in a broken scanner in the trash. Was that yours? [nervous] I put tape on it.

vo_tucker_8d7114912b.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_8d7114912b.tts_text: Oh, it chirped at me. Something scary was behind the vending machine so I told it to stay there. Then I forgot. Sorry! I'm so sorry!

vo_hollis_8815e3f261.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_8815e3f261.tts_text: Tucker, could you un-organize the aisle to staging?

vo_narrator_4326a2e389.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4326a2e389.tts_text: Tucker picks up the first pallet with the confidence of a man who has never once been told no. The second pallet goes with it. The third goes with both. There is a clatter, a shout, and a tearing sound. From inside a torn box, a small cat emerges, stretches, and walks away.

vo_tucker_03925dc548.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_03925dc548.tts_text: Yes! Absolutely! I love un-organizing! Watch this!

vo_tucker_a2000ca6be.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_a2000ca6be.tts_text: Oh no. It was in there.

vo_hollis_e318ea0fa4.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_e318ea0fa4.tts_text: Tucker. The cat bowls. Somebody put them out. Nobody's admitting to it.

vo_narrator_e38b8776f6.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e38b8776f6.tts_text: Hollis makes a mental note: there's a leaking pallet of kibble in staging, labeled "counterweight". The break room, the floor, and staging each have a bowl left. He should collect them.

vo_tucker_a3a57f4853.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_a3a57f4853.tts_text: ...It was me. There was a tote in staging leaking little brown pellets. The label said counterweight. It didn't smell like a counterweight. It smelled like a snack. And the cats looked so hungry.

vo_tucker_d3221d400e.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_d3221d400e.tts_text: Six. Now I see how that might be a problem.

vo_hollis_72418586e6.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_72418586e6.tts_text: Tucker. I need you to stand at the outbound side door and hold it open. Arms out. Don't move. Don't "help".

vo_hollis_dd280a8a75.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_dd280a8a75.tts_text: That is the whole job. It is the most important thing I'll ask of you today.

vo_tucker_74895d8b14.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_74895d8b14.tts_text: I've never been given an important job with so few steps.

vo_tucker_af08474c8e.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_af08474c8e.tts_text: That's it? That's the whole job?

vo_narrator_52e4cf5305.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_52e4cf5305.tts_text: Tucker is not in the cage. Tucker is somewhere else, doing something wonderful and unhelpful.

vo_tucker_8c90c4003e.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_8c90c4003e.tts_text: Hollis! Hi! Isn't this great? I let the cats out of the secured area but the door locked behind me and now I'm the secured area!

vo_hollis_3327d12f67.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_3327d12f67.tts_text: Halvorsen is asking where you are.

vo_torvald_016bb878a8.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_016bb878a8.tts_text: I take my breaks at dawn. Friday, door nine was up. Somebody had cut a trailer seal — 88112 — clean. And the label printer was running with nobody near it.

vo_torvald_adb7696237.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_adb7696237.tts_text: The cats? They've been camping by the drain since spring. Ask Prudence. She'll say she doesn't know. She's lying beautifully.

vo_torvald_ba722687b8.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_ba722687b8.tts_text: Halvorsen is always asking where people are. Where's that ever gotten him?

vo_torvald_ccca2c7354.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_ccca2c7354.tts_text: You found me. Impressive. Tell no one. I'm the dock spotter. I spot. That is the job.

vo_torvald_fe2a6efff5.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_fe2a6efff5.tts_text: Tucker carried a leaking tote from the trailer to staging. Says counterweight. Rattles like kibble. I know kibble. I have a dog. And I have opinions on dogs.

vo_torvald_6db47f1756.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_6db47f1756.tts_text: I told you everything. I have nothing else. I have a cigarette.

vo_torvald_60de28dbd7.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_60de28dbd7.tts_text: I already told you. Go bother Prudence.

vo_torvald_abf29dd9c6.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_abf29dd9c6.tts_text: No one thanks Torvald. I like that about you.

vo_torvald_c52084761d.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_c52084761d.tts_text: The drain. Of course. The cats know where I hide. They've always known. They sit near me. Judging. Warm.

vo_hollis_a5bb506f86.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_a5bb506f86.tts_text: I need to know what you saw Friday at 4:07.

vo_torvald_74b04b9f82.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_74b04b9f82.tts_text: Behind stacked equipment. Management has checked here twice. I stood right there both times.

vo_torvald_a1fab188bd.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_a1fab188bd.tts_text: You have the log. I have the smoke.

vo_torvald_ad0eec148d.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_ad0eec148d.tts_text: You ate a mint, didn't you. You've got the look.

vo_hollis_12ec1688b9.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_12ec1688b9.tts_text: Torvald, I need a spotter at door 3. Trailer's coming in.

vo_torvald_630bc42ac4.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_630bc42ac4.tts_text: I'll be there. I'll be the guy standing exactly where I'm supposed to be. Don't make it weird.

vo_rufus_0e23998ed5.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_0e23998ed5.tts_text: Thanks. It's at 147. It's always at 147.

vo_hollis_263367e35c.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_263367e35c.tts_text: Lost & Found. Under a pink blanket.

vo_rufus_e6a13bc915.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_e6a13bc915.tts_text: I've been counting cats by memory. Do you know how hard that is? I'm at 143. Or 147. It depends when I look.

vo_narrator_cc94ba1667.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cc94ba1667.tts_text: Rufus pulls a folded, grease-smudged map from his visor. It shows every trailer in the yard, every spot, every row, in thin ink, with dates.

vo_rufus_082c39d3a1.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_082c39d3a1.tts_text: Okay. You want to know where the trailers actually are. Not where the WMS thinks. Here.

vo_rufus_16a3361ab9.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_16a3361ab9.tts_text: Only in the computer. That's a different place.

vo_rufus_f8ecec74b6.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_f8ecec74b6.tts_text: Not yet. The WMS has that trailer on a compliance hold. If I pull it into door 3, the whole building will yell at me. Soon.

vo_rufus_08c6fe63c4.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_08c6fe63c4.tts_text: The WMS has T-9022 on a hold. If I bring it in without an override, the dock kiosk will lock the door on me. Someone needs to clear it. Maybe someone who's not technically here.

vo_rufus_775ce6052a.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_775ce6052a.tts_text: I can't see door 3 from the cab. I need a spotter at the dock, someone who knows when it's clear. Torvald is big enough to see over things.

vo_rufus_540a3a5462.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_540a3a5462.tts_text: Be at the outbound dock. I need to see you. I need the light green. Get there and radio again.

vo_narrator_aaa2783b58.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_aaa2783b58.tts_text: on the dock. I need all eight.

vo_narrator_954980c403.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_954980c403.tts_text: Bruno slides the jack under the first pallet. Then the second. Torvald calls the dock plate. Tucker holds the door. The cats are somewhere better. One by one, the eight pallets go into the trailer.

vo_bruno_76157477c3.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_76157477c3.tts_text: Not until I have a bill of lading, remote confirmation, and Kestrel's okay. [pause] But that looks like a real load. It looks like a load somebody planned.

vo_bruno_7a2273b782.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_7a2273b782.tts_text: Eight loads. One through eight. Nothing on the floor. No cats. Trailer's full and correct.

vo_tabitha_1ab2063e13.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_1ab2063e13.tts_text: It's brand-new. I wrote it this morning. I'm very proud. It's the first time I've made a policy on the spot. It feels... powerful.

vo_tabitha_37043d43f3.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_37043d43f3.tts_text: Cats are a learning opportunity! With paperwork.

vo_tabitha_92b00d99c3.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_92b00d99c3.tts_text: Juno has been its most active member in years. She hasn't missed a meeting. Nobody has told her when the meetings are.

vo_gus_ab8a6b0401.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_ab8a6b0401.tts_text: Then no. Regional rules. I can't bend those. I'm pretty sure that's the only rule I'm allowed to know.

vo_narrator_4cd419fbc8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4cd419fbc8.tts_text: Gus's eyes flick briefly to a monitor showing Rack 14. Then away.

vo_gus_444c44914f.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_444c44914f.tts_text: Prudence? I'm aware Prudence is present. Yes. We've all been aware. Security has determined this is an Operations matter.

vo_hollis_5e5460124e.speaker: HOLLIS
vo_hollis_5e5460124e.tts_text: Operations says it's a Security matter.

vo_gus_636cb68f22.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_636cb68f22.tts_text: I have eight monitors. Six of them have cats on them. I've made my peace.

vo_gus_fbed812b6c.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_fbed812b6c.tts_text: I didn't say anything about Conveyor 9. I'm not saying anything about the server closet either. That's the sort of thing that wouldn't appear on a monitor I'm watching.

vo_gus_ff59f1aade.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_ff59f1aade.tts_text: I don't know that word. What word is that?

vo_narrator_012f17d62b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_012f17d62b.tts_text: Renata and her volunteers walk the ramp. A steady, gentle line of cats climbs into the vans. One by one, they're counted.

vo_narrator_87b2df468d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_87b2df468d.tts_text: Renata looks at Juno, at the armband, at Juno's posture. Juno sits, ears up, tail slow.

vo_renata_2f63e75cff.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_2f63e75cff.tts_text: She's a natural. We could use her. [pause] No, you can't give her to us.

vo_renata_ba36fd85ca.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_ba36fd85ca.tts_text: You must be Hollis. I'm Renata. This is the largest colony I've ever been called to. And the best-organized.

vo_renata_168b1d8e55.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_168b1d8e55.tts_text: Two hundred and fourteen. Fed, healthy, mostly judgmental. The colony leader, an orange one, walked in like he was reviewing the accommodations. Somebody named them all. Prudence, I'm told. [pause] Is she... employed here?

vo_renata_895cb0447b.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_895cb0447b.tts_text: The last few, the ones who like the office, can stay if they want. They've got seniority.

vo_renata_5ecdcfe035.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_5ecdcfe035.tts_text: They're all settled. Thank you for the trailer. Really. And the blanket. They love the blanket.

vo_narrator_7456985249.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7456985249.tts_text: Hollis would call someone, but his phone is in his locker. Somewhere in the locker area is a locker with his name on it, or his initials.

vo_narrator_52302b2a68.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_52302b2a68.tts_text: Hollis thumbs through his contacts. The phone reminds him it has 4% battery. It has had 4% for a while.

vo_ingrid_8d661b2424.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_8d661b2424.tts_text: I'm four feet from where you were. Come in person. It's cheaper.

vo_halvorsen_22586de4d5.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_22586de4d5.tts_text: Yes. Is it the shipment? It's always the shipment. Fine. Keep going. Did you check the dashboard? It's green.

vo_narrator_05d77617ee.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_05d77617ee.tts_text: Hollis reaches for his radio. It is not there. It is behind the vending machine.

vo_halvorsen_2c573dc194.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_2c573dc194.tts_text: Yes? Is it the shipment? Fine. Also, if you see cats: they aren't there.

vo_halvorsen_d6fa9d3be2.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_d6fa9d3be2.tts_text: Status? Give me a number. Any number. I'll take a green one.

vo_bruno_1639bfc5f1.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_1639bfc5f1.tts_text: Eight to Kestrel. Right eight. I'm eating lunch.

vo_bruno_85265a9a3f.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_85265a9a3f.tts_text: Trailer at the door and I'll load. I need to see it. You know where to find me.

vo_bruno_95e543828f.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_95e543828f.tts_text: Find me an H-17 seal for this jack, then we talk.

vo_bruno_fc0bcb6cce.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_fc0bcb6cce.tts_text: Orange dot: mine, ships. Blue dot: stays inside. No dot: I didn't touch it — cat or label. Kestrel's PO tells you the rest.

vo_rufus_6109bb342e.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_6109bb342e.tts_text: I'd love to talk, but I'm off count without my clicker. It's... somewhere lost.

vo_ingrid_5b42d31cbf.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_5b42d31cbf.tts_text: Come to my desk. The radio is for emergencies. Everything is a small emergency, but this isn't one.

vo_tucker_4b66bca0e8.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_4b66bca0e8.tts_text: Hollis! You're calling ME? I'm great! What can I help with? I'm holding a pallet. A different one. I'm fine.

vo_tucker_7cc08f68c4.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_7cc08f68c4.tts_text: Hollis! I'm in the cage! It's cozy! The key is in Parts somewhere! Probably!

vo_tucker_ce9c118777.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_ce9c118777.tts_text: I'm holding the door! I'm not moving! Is it working?

vo_narrator_1425e6643b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1425e6643b.tts_text: Hollis sits down at the break-room table. Juno follows him in and settles at his feet. The lights, at long last, stop flickering.

vo_narrator_cc63e72409.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cc63e72409.tts_text: The vending machine makes a noise. It is not a good noise. It is not a bad noise. It is a noise like a thought.

vo_narrator_0cd497a1b3.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0cd497a1b3.tts_text: A cat slowly walks into the break room.

vo_narrator_6e7de0fc46.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6e7de0fc46.tts_text: Hollis stares at it. Juno stares at Hollis.

vo_narrator_ab86e9d627.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ab86e9d627.tts_text: One glowing mint drops into the tray.

vo_narrator_b1269139b3.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b1269139b3.tts_text: A large orange cat, sitting like a sergeant, with a slightly chewed sheet of paper stuck to the fur of his side like a medal. He looks at Hollis with authority and, faintly, hunger.

vo_scanner_56c971b569.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_56c971b569.tts_text: CAT — SGT. BISCUIT. Rank: colony leader. Attached document: MANIFEST T-4417, PAGE 2 OF 2. Status: "worn as a medal". Weakness: fish crackers, 80%.

vo_narrator_099926dc24.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_099926dc24.tts_text: The paper is loosened by a neat sweep of a paw. It slides off his fur and lands at Hollis's feet.

vo_narrator_0e2b24133e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0e2b24133e.tts_text: Hollis offers the fish crackers. Sergeant Biscuit sniffs. He considers. He eats one with the dignity of a sommelier.

vo_prudence_04dcf22564.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_04dcf22564.tts_text: Oh, don't. I'm not technically in possession of that.

vo_narrator_ff8be29ba1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ff8be29ba1.tts_text: Hollis lays a line of kibble along the main aisle, from the racks toward the outbound dock. It's like leaving breadcrumbs, except for two hundred hungry witnesses.

vo_narrator_1e28cea392.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1e28cea392.tts_text: Hollis slits the stretched wrap. A small waterfall of brown pellets pours out. It smells like fish, tuna, and the entire history of feline temptation. This is not a counterweight.

vo_narrator_542bed482c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_542bed482c.tts_text: Hollis has enough kibble. Nobody needs a buffet.

vo_narrator_d7c49ea171.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d7c49ea171.tts_text: The shrink wrap is committed. Whatever is inside, the pallet is not going to volunteer it.

vo_narrator_4cfa0cb36e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4cfa0cb36e.tts_text: Hollis grabs the vending machine and pulls. It tilts. It considers. It commits.

vo_narrator_b872080f72.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b872080f72.tts_text: Hollis looks at the forklift. The keys are in it. Nobody is watching.

vo_tucker_b533dcbc59.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_b533dcbc59.tts_text: Oh thank goodness! I thought I broke it! [pause] I did break it.

vo_narrator_0c6df18571.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0c6df18571.tts_text: The parts gate is locked. Hollis tries the old brass key. It fits like it was cut for a fired employee. Click. He's in.

vo_narrator_53489f8144.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_53489f8144.tts_text: Juno is not here. Hollis pets the air out of habit.

vo_narrator_7f8845bb43.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7f8845bb43.tts_text: Hollis pets Juno. Juno accepts this as her due.

vo_narrator_c51565eb17.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c51565eb17.tts_text: Hollis extends a hand toward a cat. The cat considers it, allows exactly two strokes, and then files a complaint with its eyes.

vo_narrator_f80c4707ea.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f80c4707ea.tts_text: There is no cat here. It is a strange thing to miss.

vo_narrator_6b84902652.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6b84902652.tts_text: Feeding the cats is how this started. Nobody is going to say that out loud, but the narrator is thinking it.

vo_narrator_fd44e581d3.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fd44e581d3.tts_text: Hollis has never hit anything at work. It is why he is still employed. Mostly.

vo_narrator_fcaa28a0c1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fcaa28a0c1.tts_text: Hollis considers it. HR, somewhere, sits up in its chair. He does not.

vo_narrator_789f9d0113.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_789f9d0113.tts_text: Hollis is tempted. That is how the day started. He stays standing.

vo_narrator_5130af4126.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5130af4126.tts_text: Hollis does none of that. He is a professional. He is also very tall, and it would not end well near the racks.

vo_narrator_0c3ae8a93a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0c3ae8a93a.tts_text: Hollis yells. The warehouse, which has heard everything, has no response. A cat blinks.

vo_narrator_82dff676f8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_82dff676f8.tts_text: Hollis does not smoke. That is Torvald's department, and Torvald would like it to stay that way.

vo_narrator_54a0ea9d7a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_54a0ea9d7a.tts_text: Hollis does not have any coffee. The break room pot smells like a rumor.

vo_narrator_cec36562af.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cec36562af.tts_text: It is the last decent coffee. It is not Hollis's. It has a destination.

vo_narrator_7d1ad06fef.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7d1ad06fef.tts_text: Hollis does not have a mint. Yet.

vo_narrator_e19e76684e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e19e76684e.tts_text: Hollis holds the mint at arm's length. Not yet. Not until it is a real problem.

vo_narrator_a125dbdc23.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a125dbdc23.tts_text: Nothing happens. Wrong game. The vending machine hums, judgmentally.

vo_narrator_c81e5f0f19.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c81e5f0f19.tts_text: Hollis: tall, skinny, cap, gray shirt, blue vest, boots, stubble. He looks like a man who has already seen the incident report.

vo_narrator_89434f98c0.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_89434f98c0.tts_text: The game saves itself as you go. The warehouse does not.

vo_narrator_fbbe75f3f7.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fbbe75f3f7.tts_text: Hollis considers quitting. He has considered it since 2019. He is still here.

vo_narrator_8140313ba7.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8140313ba7.tts_text: Hollis swears mildly. A cat looks away, out of courtesy.

vo_narrator_9500525c0e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9500525c0e.tts_text: Hollis waits. The clock in the break room agrees it is 9:02.

vo_narrator_4c633cf2c7.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4c633cf2c7.tts_text: Hollis considers that command. The parser considers Hollis. Neither is moved.

vo_narrator_af65c48384.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_af65c48384.tts_text: Hollis looks for a way to go there. He does not find one.

vo_narrator_59394c9639.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_59394c9639.tts_text: Using a forklift on that is technically a workplace incident. Hollis declines.

vo_narrator_e9983d0181.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e9983d0181.tts_text: The door to the locker area. Beyond it, the sounds of a warehouse having a day.

vo_narrator_eeae34a3d0.speaker: NARRATOR

vo_narrator_b4ae486825.tts_text: The racking aisles, going back further than anyone has surveyed.

vo_scanner_bf3db46539.tts_text: INGRID — Knows: everything. Says: 11%. Owes: nobody. Needs: coffee, CRITICAL.

vo_scanner_cb2d06d5b1.tts_text: HALVORSEN — Stress: CRITICAL. Confidence in dashboard: 91%. Confidence in warehouse: pending. Currently waiting on: a call from someone.

vo_scanner_e81091ec1b.tts_text: BADGE READER — Access: REGIONAL. Your access: "hah".

vo_narrator_5229998515.tts_text: A scanner battery pack with strips of electrical tape still on it. Held in a clock for who knows how long. It has a little green LED, which is optimistic.

vo_narrator_c105e2393c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c105e2393c.tts_text: Your cell phone. 4% battery. It has been at 4% since Thursday. It appears to run on stubbornness.

vo_narrator_e5e846b1fd.tts_text: A mug of what may indeed be the last decent coffee in the building. It is hot. It is precious. It should not be wasted on anyone who has not earned it.

vo_narrator_a069fef8bb.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a069fef8bb.tts_text: A blue pen. It writes. In this building, that alone is a distinction.

vo_narrator_e755a485ef.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e755a485ef.tts_text: A leather work glove the size of a small oven mitt. It smells like pine, tobacco, and a Viking with very little interest in being found.

vo_narrator_419fbd048e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_419fbd048e.tts_text: A pink blanket that has been through some things. It is soft. It has a cat hair on it, which is either a coincidence or a preview.

vo_narrator_5ce6527d92.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5ce6527d92.tts_text: A hydraulic seal kit for a pallet jack. Small, unloved, and the difference between a working shift and a crawling one.

vo_narrator_714cf49d80.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_714cf49d80.tts_text: An old brass key on a Parts Department lanyard, faded to "PARTS". It came from a person who is technically not authorized to possess it. Presumably she possesses it in a technical sense.

vo_narrator_8942eaa052.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8942eaa052.tts_text: The maintenance cage key. The tag says "IF FOUND SEE TUCKER". Tucker is in the cage. This is the world working as intended.

vo_narrator_3977cb310e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3977cb310e.tts_text: Bruno's pallet jack, repaired, in your pocket. It is, by any standard, physically impossible to carry in a pocket. The inventory has never asked.

vo_narrator_243d9c9106.tts_text: A scoop of feline nutrition, bulk grade, in an old tote lid. It smells irresistible to cats and, evidently, to everything with whiskers within a half-mile.

vo_narrator_2027ec8b84.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_2027ec8b84.tts_text: A small round mint, glowing a soft, confident green-white. It hums, faintly, at a frequency Hollis associates with the fluorescent lights at 9:02. Several company policies prohibit it. None of them name it.

vo_narrator_17e480e8fd.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_17e480e8fd.tts_text: A grease-stained spiral notebook: "SMOKE LOG". Entries: "FRI 4:07 AM — HALO printer prints by itself. Label kiosk approves own directive. Says 'thank you' out loud. Time: 4:07. Note: nobody was there but me and a cat." Signed: TORVALD. Witness.

vo_narrator_350c273636.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_350c273636.tts_text: The bill of lading for T-9022: eight loads, correct pallet IDs, correct serials, correct destination, printed by a woman who was told the truth. It is the cleanest piece of paper in the building.

vo_narrator_53096cfd8b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_53096cfd8b.tts_text: It is bolted down, in a way that suggests someone else has already tried.

vo_narrator_bfeacaae7b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_bfeacaae7b.tts_text: Hollis has taken enough things that were not his today. He declines.

vo_narrator_e4af661e3d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e4af661e3d.tts_text: Taking that would create paperwork. Hollis is at capacity.

vo_narrator_0406ed919e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0406ed919e.tts_text: It does not open. Or it does, and nothing interesting happens.

vo_narrator_e876fb1ac5.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e876fb1ac5.tts_text: Hollis checks. It is as open as it is going to get.

vo_narrator_104c089b0a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_104c089b0a.tts_text: Pushing it would only relocate the problem.

vo_narrator_ede0e3e8ff.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ede0e3e8ff.tts_text: Hollis pushes. It stays. The warehouse wins again.

vo_narrator_69db5e3d68.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_69db5e3d68.tts_text: Hollis pulls. Nothing. The universe declines the transaction.

vo_narrator_8e672976a7.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8e672976a7.tts_text: It does not budge. It has clearly been there longer than Hollis has.

vo_narrator_0ce05b8d44.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0ce05b8d44.tts_text: A conversation with that would be one-sided, even by warehouse standards.

vo_narrator_909f539282.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_909f539282.tts_text: Hollis talks to it. It has no comment at this time.

vo_narrator_924ebbd933.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_924ebbd933.tts_text: It does not want anything from Hollis. Rare.

vo_narrator_a611ccc8d7.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a611ccc8d7.tts_text: Hollis cannot think of a productive use for that. Or a safe one.

vo_narrator_f0a9e6fcb7.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f0a9e6fcb7.tts_text: Using that would be a procedure. There is no procedure.

vo_scanner_55becfcbd2.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_55becfcbd2.tts_text: Beep. Nothing. The scanner does not care either.

vo_narrator_3ca8f1f95a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3ca8f1f95a.tts_text: It looks like it belongs here.

vo_narrator_5e528eb6bb.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5e528eb6bb.tts_text: Hollis has seen it a thousand times. It has not improved.

vo_narrator_41bd9e4e61.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_41bd9e4e61.tts_text: Juno sniffs. It smells like warehouse. Everything does.

vo_narrator_c2bf460b15.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c2bf460b15.tts_text: Juno looks at it, then at Hollis. She has no notes.

vo_narrator_7c4f49051f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7c4f49051f.tts_text: That combination is not in any training module. Possibly for good reason.

vo_narrator_3128c8fb9a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3128c8fb9a.tts_text: That would work in a world with fewer rules. This is not that world.

vo_narrator_77347a6f14.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_77347a6f14.tts_text: Hollis considers it, then considers the incident report. Hard pass.

vo_narrator_e46153f4c6.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e46153f4c6.tts_text: Nothing happens. The narrator is relieved.

vo_narrator_660f23d603.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_660f23d603.tts_text: Tucker opens his arms for a hug. Hollis reconsiders.

vo_narrator_9ba5e84683.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9ba5e84683.tts_text: Tucker volunteers to be useful. That is exactly how Hollis got into this.

vo_narrator_ac6e75b661.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ac6e75b661.tts_text: Hollis tries to take Tucker. Tucker helpfully goes limp, then helpfully stands up, then helpfully offers to carry himself.

vo_narrator_cf29244877.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cf29244877.tts_text: Hollis nudges Tucker. Tucker assumes it is a drill, and evacuates the wrong way with great enthusiasm.

vo_tucker_97c10c37b2.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_97c10c37b2.tts_text: Oh, for me?! What is it for?

vo_bruno_5ba5df0681.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_5ba5df0681.tts_text: I am not equipment. I work with equipment.

vo_bruno_6fce1608c3.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_6fce1608c3.tts_text: I don't need that. Unless it's a seal, a jack, or a signed bill.

vo_narrator_089849adf3.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_089849adf3.tts_text: Bruno lets himself be pulled exactly one step, out of courtesy.

vo_narrator_0f7d2f0dd8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0f7d2f0dd8.tts_text: Bruno is about six-two and does not take well to being taken.

vo_narrator_8c35ff4316.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8c35ff4316.tts_text: Hollis pushes Bruno. Bruno does not move. Bruno notes the attempt in a look.

vo_narrator_b76fd10d1a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b76fd10d1a.tts_text: Bruno has no zippers, doors, or hatches. He is a very simple machine.

vo_ingrid_31a291ba34.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_31a291ba34.tts_text: I am not a resource. I am a bottleneck. Big difference.

vo_ingrid_7682ef6ae1.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_7682ef6ae1.tts_text: If that creates work for me, I will hand it back.

vo_narrator_64a92d8aaa.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_64a92d8aaa.tts_text: Ingrid is at her desk. She will be at her desk when this is over.

vo_narrator_a010c5e6a1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a010c5e6a1.tts_text: Ingrid looks at Hollis over her glasses. Hollis puts his hands back where they were.

vo_narrator_db5067b846.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_db5067b846.tts_text: Ingrid has not moved from that chair since the last time the printer worked.

vo_narrator_b791696a1c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b791696a1c.tts_text: Prudence drifts a step in the direction Hollis pushed and is now standing somewhere more useful.

vo_narrator_e976035ec6.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e976035ec6.tts_text: Prudence has been taken away before. It did not take.

vo_prudence_96c708ce97.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_96c708ce97.tts_text: I have been used before. I get paid in coffee.

vo_prudence_c8c9c3a204.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_c8c9c3a204.tts_text: We're not really touching people today.

vo_prudence_c958ac58a9.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_c958ac58a9.tts_text: Oh, don't. I am not technically in possession of anything.

vo_narrator_6ba739df0a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6ba739df0a.tts_text: Hollis pushes Torvald. Torvald is pushed about one inch and then decides that is far enough.

vo_narrator_8f8a4d65e6.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8f8a4d65e6.tts_text: Torvald is a Viking. Hollis does not take Vikings. Hollis is not that kind of raider.

vo_torvald_12c8de79a3.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_12c8de79a3.tts_text: I am not that kind of open.

vo_torvald_151e6eac11.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_151e6eac11.tts_text: Pull as hard as you want. I sit where I sit.

vo_torvald_f0a8977395.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_f0a8977395.tts_text: I am on my break. You cannot use me during my break.

vo_narrator_00e3630808.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_00e3630808.tts_text: Rufus is in the cab of the yard truck. Hollis would have to take the truck too.

vo_narrator_cf2af870f9.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cf2af870f9.tts_text: Rufus opens the truck door, looks at Hollis, closes it.

vo_rufus_7d2db4dc2a.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_7d2db4dc2a.tts_text: Just put it on the dash.

vo_rufus_91e1ee381e.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_91e1ee381e.tts_text: I am used exactly once a day, at the right time.

vo_halvorsen_5767468190.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_5767468190.tts_text: If you're going to pull me into it, it needs to be a signed Form 7-Q.

vo_halvorsen_6a21ac22e1.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_6a21ac22e1.tts_text: Put it in the tray. There is no tray. Just put it on the pile.

vo_halvorsen_83213cc72b.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_83213cc72b.tts_text: I am not a metric. Am I?

vo_narrator_6bb5a8f127.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6bb5a8f127.tts_text: Halvorsen is already leaning on the edge. Hollis doesn't want to be the one.

vo_narrator_8a66f5b4f8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8a66f5b4f8.tts_text: Halvorsen has already been taken. By the job.

vo_narrator_8ed1b337a8.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8ed1b337a8.tts_text: Halvorsen is closed. He has been closed since Q2.

vo_tabitha_5e3db32857.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_5e3db32857.tts_text: We have a policy for that. It says please don't.

vo_tabitha_b0fed8da4e.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_b0fed8da4e.tts_text: I'm here to help, not to be used. Different form.

vo_tabitha_b363ffc099.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_b363ffc099.tts_text: That is not a policy-compliant interaction.

vo_tabitha_baa8a9ecaf.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_baa8a9ecaf.tts_text: That would need to be a formal incident report. I have the form!

vo_tabitha_cf1e3a0770.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_cf1e3a0770.tts_text: I am always open. My door is open. My mind is... in policy.

vo_gus_604dbdc5e2.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_604dbdc5e2.tts_text: I don't accept gifts. The last one had a cat in it.

vo_gus_7ee9c451e6.speaker: GUS
vo_gus_7ee9c451e6.tts_text: Can't be used. Can't be moved. Can't let you through.

vo_narrator_966368e222.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_966368e222.tts_text: Gus is bigger than the door he guards. Hollis leaves him where he is.

vo_narrator_f619aed316.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f619aed316.tts_text: Gus is the stairs. Nobody moves the stairs.

vo_narrator_37ee8c2093.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_37ee8c2093.tts_text: Renata's clipboard is open. That is as open as she gets.

vo_narrator_fe138a448d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fe138a448d.tts_text: Renata is not for taking. She is for calling.

vo_renata_8157d1581e.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_8157d1581e.tts_text: I am on your side. That is different from being used.

vo_renata_a60fc5fe53.speaker: RENATA
vo_renata_a60fc5fe53.tts_text: Kibble is fine. Otherwise, no thank you.

vo_harrow_0136ed9d27.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_0136ed9d27.tts_text: Submit that through the proper channel. There is no proper channel.

vo_harrow_50fdb6bee2.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_50fdb6bee2.tts_text: I am the regional director. I am the one who uses.

vo_harrow_9d448611a8.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_9d448611a8.tts_text: The review is open. The floor is not.

vo_harrow_b4cbbf8da5.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_b4cbbf8da5.tts_text: Please keep your hands in the meeting.

vo_narrator_5e5676c73c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5e5676c73c.tts_text: Harrow is not for taking. Harrow is for reviewing.

vo_narrator_fcd73e8b88.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fcd73e8b88.tts_text: Harrow is already on the edge. Hollis is not going to be the reason.

vo_narrator_5852554220.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_5852554220.tts_text: Hollis decides not to push a coworker. Growth.

vo_narrator_64ee65ef1a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_64ee65ef1a.tts_text: Hollis tugs a sleeve. The sleeve is unimpressed.

vo_narrator_85b992a439.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_85b992a439.tts_text: People are not for taking. It says so in the handbook. Somewhere.

vo_narrator_ebe0b02376.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ebe0b02376.tts_text: They do not want that. Hollis is not sure anyone does.

vo_narrator_fa1f1d2e8d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fa1f1d2e8d.tts_text: Hollis is not qualified to open a person.

vo_narrator_559cc0ec44.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_559cc0ec44.tts_text: Hollis pushes. It is heavier than it looks. It is heavier than it sounds.

vo_narrator_6d55c2a659.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6d55c2a659.tts_text: There is a hood, a hatch and a warning label. He leaves all three alone.

vo_narrator_76f235c69c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_76f235c69c.tts_text: Hollis is not certified on that today. The narrator checks. He is not.

vo_narrator_d8b16aec5d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d8b16aec5d.tts_text: Hollis cannot take a piece of equipment. His pockets are big, but they are not that big.

vo_narrator_de8759b426.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_de8759b426.tts_text: Hollis pulls. Equipment has a way of being where it is.

vo_narrator_f3da0c1b87.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f3da0c1b87.tts_text: Hollis talks to the machine. It is diesel, and does not care.

vo_narrator_4f258aef86.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4f258aef86.tts_text: Hollis leans on it. Freight remains freight.

vo_narrator_6940b31190.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6940b31190.tts_text: Best practice is not to pull loaded freight by hand. The narrator has read the module.

vo_narrator_b2c891762a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b2c891762a.tts_text: Hollis cannot take a pallet. He can move it with the correct equipment.

vo_narrator_bf6d363d3e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_bf6d363d3e.tts_text: The freight declines to comment. It has been in staging for a week and has a lot to be quiet about.

vo_narrator_ec05ee3715.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ec05ee3715.tts_text: Hollis is not going to use that on anything without a jack and a plan.

vo_narrator_781596d7d4.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_781596d7d4.tts_text: Hollis presses a few buttons. Nothing useful. It rebooted itself out of spite.

vo_narrator_867ad1c4bd.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_867ad1c4bd.tts_text: Hollis pushes. It beeps, out of habit.

vo_narrator_ad1707b666.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ad1707b666.tts_text: Hollis talks to it. It beeps politely, which is more than most machines do.

vo_narrator_ad27a85054.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_ad27a85054.tts_text: There is a panel. Behind it there is another panel. Hollis stops there.

vo_narrator_e3f6872eb1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e3f6872eb1.tts_text: Hollis pulls the cord. It complains in one long tone. He puts it back.

vo_narrator_f72d4bc455.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f72d4bc455.tts_text: It is bolted, plugged in, and probably audited.

vo_narrator_05d6fa0533.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_05d6fa0533.tts_text: It has no flap. It is a poster with intentions.

vo_narrator_3b423f5b70.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3b423f5b70.tts_text: Hollis pulls. A corner comes off, and he sticks it back.

vo_narrator_6351a7390b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_6351a7390b.tts_text: Hollis reads it aloud. It is no better out loud.

vo_narrator_88a959eb43.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_88a959eb43.tts_text: Pushing paper is, technically, what most of Operations does.

vo_narrator_b0f55e967c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_b0f55e967c.tts_text: It is stapled to the wall by someone who meant it.

vo_narrator_fde7296e84.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_fde7296e84.tts_text: Hollis briefly considers acting on it. Then he reads it again.

vo_narrator_04397a2ad2.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_04397a2ad2.tts_text: It moves a little. It is heavier than a piece of furniture has a right to be.

vo_narrator_634e24e377.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_634e24e377.tts_text: Hollis opens it. Everything inside is exactly what he expected.

vo_narrator_873a8bf20d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_873a8bf20d.tts_text: Hollis asks it how its day is going. It looks like a piece of furniture.

vo_narrator_e950cfbf42.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e950cfbf42.tts_text: It scrapes a few inches and settles. It preferred the old spot.

vo_narrator_f2f8faba8e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f2f8faba8e.tts_text: Hollis sits, stands, and sits again. It does not solve anything.

vo_narrator_1015ff4090.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1015ff4090.tts_text: Hollis cannot take a door. He has considered it.

vo_narrator_3155303761.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3155303761.tts_text: Hollis pushes. The door was not designed to be pushed by an employee.

vo_narrator_4aca58e2c7.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4aca58e2c7.tts_text: It does not open the way Hollis wants. It opens like a bureaucracy: slowly, and on a different day.

vo_narrator_e80c9e3e98.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e80c9e3e98.tts_text: Hollis talks to the door. A cat on the other side does not answer.

vo_narrator_e95b4bcfdc.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_e95b4bcfdc.tts_text: Hollis pulls. The door is about as excited as he is.

vo_narrator_f0d28bec3c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f0d28bec3c.tts_text: Hollis uses the door to go in and out. This does not count as a puzzle.

vo_narrator_1219ab8735.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1219ab8735.tts_text: Hollis lines up the ITEM with the THING, and then notices a cat watching. He lowers the ITEM.

vo_narrator_4f2342290f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4f2342290f.tts_text: The ITEM and the THING have no business together. HR would need a form for that.

vo_narrator_bcd603190a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_bcd603190a.tts_text: Hollis holds up the ITEM. The THING is unmoved. The narrator is a little impressed.

vo_narrator_c2c170f3a3.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c2c170f3a3.tts_text: Hollis thinks about using the ITEM on the THING. The THING has not done anything to deserve it.

vo_narrator_cb870e6288.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cb870e6288.tts_text: That is not how the ITEM works. That is not how the THING works. That is not how anything works.

vo_narrator_552cf6dea2.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_552cf6dea2.tts_text: The bulletin board. "EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH: VACANT, since 2019". "Your safety is our priority, please see Forms 3 through 41." And a hand-lettered flyer at the bottom.

vo_narrator_aec654ad54.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_aec654ad54.tts_text: It says WHISKER RIDGE CAT RESCUE, with a phone number. "We handle LARGE groups." Someone has underlined LARGE.

vo_scanner_ec2da2fbb2.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_ec2da2fbb2.tts_text: VENDING MACHINE — Asset class: "Snack Depot 3". Contents: 6 items, 1 rumor. Last serviced: "yes".

vo_narrator_8bd524f6f2.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8bd524f6f2.tts_text: It sounds like Operations. It sounds tired.

vo_narrator_67b90621fc.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_67b90621fc.tts_text: KA-CHUNK. A bag of "Salty Little Fish" drops. It smells like an idea.

vo_narrator_cf70123d35.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_cf70123d35.tts_text: D4 blinks "SOLD OUT" at you and hums. It is waiting for something.

vo_narrator_80e59e0e56.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_80e59e0e56.tts_text: He is going to eat it anyway. That is what "desperate enough" looks like.

vo_narrator_3b99e5fc7e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3b99e5fc7e.tts_text: MINT MODE: ACTIVE. Perception: logistics. Duration: "unclear. The scanner has stopped asking.", Press M to toggle vision.

vo_narrator_571683ba1d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_571683ba1d.tts_text: The box is now "Found & Lost". Hollis feels good about that.

vo_scanner_ffc60635e4.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_ffc60635e4.tts_text: MISMATCH LOGGED to scan history: "F-2231, plate vs. records disagree."

vo_narrator_12188aff1c.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_12188aff1c.tts_text: Someone has added "OUT 11:59" in green, with a tick.

vo_narrator_78e92dae5d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_78e92dae5d.tts_text: The whiteboard. "HOT SHIPMENT, rush order: the customer is losing money every hour — KESTREL MOTOR WORKS — 8 LOADS, eight pallets of parts — OUT BY 12:00, NOON. NO EXCEPTIONS." Under it, someone has written "CATS: " and then nothing, as if the marker died in the attempt.

vo_narrator_9a077e562f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9a077e562f.tts_text: Tucker's pallet wall blocks the aisle to the staging lanes. It would take a small army, or one person who understands the difference between "organized" and "obstructed".

vo_narrator_7a6b9d227e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7a6b9d227e.tts_text: Ingrid, the shipping clerk. Every piece of paper in the building eventually stops at her desk to rest. She has the look of someone who has said "that's not my department" for so long it became her department.

vo_scanner_dbff6ae013.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_dbff6ae013.tts_text: WMS TERMINAL — Status: "Reconciled". Reality: "Pending." The scanner and the terminal have never gotten along.

vo_narrator_daff637853.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_daff637853.tts_text: The big HALO dashboard, corporate's scoreboard for every site, showing every regional site at a serene 100%. The glow flickers oddly, as if there is more underneath. A graph shows "Cat Population" as a flat line at zero, labeled "N/A, no approved metric".

vo_narrator_984363e90d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_984363e90d.tts_text: DIRECTIVE 7-C: "Any freight with an unassigned destination shall be assigned to the nearest site with a shortfall." ORIGIN: Regional Operations, automated template. AUTO-APPROVED BY: HALO. FIRST APPLIED: FRIDAY 4:07 AM.

vo_halvorsen_25ea30070a.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_25ea30070a.tts_text: There is no cat problem. There is no approved metric for "warehouse cats." Therefore there are no warehouse cats. a cat walks across his desk Please don't look at that.

vo_harrow_d8a2c944af.speaker: HARROW
vo_harrow_d8a2c944af.tts_text: However, I'm seeing an anomaly. Someone in your building has been "verifying" freight with a handheld device and — — chewing my metrics. I'd like to review this in person.

vo_tabitha_d08bb7753a.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_d08bb7753a.tts_text: Hollis! Great. It's 9:02! Your mandatory screening. I'm just going to run the tablet.

vo_tablet_1ce8c789f1.speaker: TABLET
vo_tablet_1ce8c789f1.tts_text: ERROR 4-0-9:02 — SUBSTANCE NOT FOUND IN DATABASE. RECLASSIFYING AS: "BREATH, NON-STANDARD". RECLASSIFYING AS: "WEATHER". RECLASSIFYING AS: "TUESDAY".

vo_narrator_d09fb1c4cb.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d09fb1c4cb.tts_text: The HR printer wakes up and begins printing shipping labels. Hundreds. One says "BREATH". One says "TENNESSEE".

vo_tabitha_072149bb46.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_072149bb46.tts_text: I have a policy for cats. It's Policy 88. It says: "Cats are not permitted." Nobody has ever told them.

vo_narrator_3b47415eb9.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3b47415eb9.tts_text: Bin H-17: "HYDRAULIC SEALS". Empty now, apart from a tiny fossilized donut.

vo_narrator_944492d7ba.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_944492d7ba.tts_text: Bin H-17: "HYDRAULIC SEALS". One seal remains in the bin, next to a tiny fossilized donut.

vo_narrator_9d82e37a29.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9d82e37a29.tts_text: A disused conveyor tunnel, hidden behind Rack 14, still marked "CONVEYOR 9". It goes somewhere. Cats go there.

vo_narrator_51f3a74421.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_51f3a74421.tts_text: The storage slots are ready to receive freight. A sign says "STORAGE: PLEASE PUT WHERE IT BELONGS" and someone has added ", WMS: HAHA".

vo_narrator_da0c2191aa.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_da0c2191aa.tts_text: A board announcing that staging is occupied by inbound freight and that outbound freight will therefore be "assigned space at a later date". It is the later date.

vo_narrator_9dae3c65bc.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9dae3c65bc.tts_text: The inbound label printer. It has a small screen showing "TEMPLATES: 000, TEST, 001, RECEIVING, 002, OUTBOUND...". Template 000 is marked "ADMIN — GROUND TRUTH REFERENCE — DO NOT USE".

vo_narrator_d4ce507d0e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_d4ce507d0e.tts_text: Labels are landing everywhere. Each says "TEST TEST TEST" and, in tiny print, "T."

vo_narrator_89fc8b9d2e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_89fc8b9d2e.tts_text: The load plan. "KESTREL — DOOR 3 — TRAILER T-9022 — 8 LOADS." Bruno has drawn eight little boxes and, next to each, a small colored dot. Two colors: orange and blue.

vo_narrator_a453613dee.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a453613dee.tts_text: All eight boxes are ticked. Next to them: "11:59".

vo_scanner_90b7db7db3.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_90b7db7db3.tts_text: DOOR 3 — TRAILER: T-9022, per WMS. PHYSICAL: EMPTY. Search radius 0.5 miles: NOT FOUND.

vo_narrator_9c152e1dc3.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_9c152e1dc3.tts_text: The dock light cycles. Rufus needs the word GO at exactly the right time: not before, not after.

vo_narrator_977ea1bde5.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_977ea1bde5.tts_text: Hollis hands the bill of lading to Bruno. Bruno reads it top to bottom, nods once the way people nod at a good weld, and tears off the yellow carbon copy.

vo_ingrid_c294887d26.speaker: INGRID
vo_ingrid_c294887d26.tts_text: I know. I just printed it.

vo_bruno_87dd8b856b.speaker: BRUNO
vo_bruno_87dd8b856b.tts_text: File copy. You will want it.

vo_scanner_0726f1a847.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_0726f1a847.tts_text: ROW C — WMS: 0 trailers. PHYSICAL: 5 trailers, 41 cats, approximate. Reconciliation: "ha".

vo_scanner_0f3726d22c.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_0f3726d22c.tts_text: TRAILER 31 — Status: EMPTY. Function: "Temporary Holding". Capacity: 250 cats, est.. Confidence: "cautiously feline".

vo_scanner_7bdf2386d5.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_7bdf2386d5.tts_text: TRAILER 31 — Status: OCCUPIED, 214. Function: "Temporary Holding". Confidence: "cautiously feline".

vo_scanner_0a9d0c0931.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_0a9d0c0931.tts_text: ERROR. SUBJECT DETECTED AS "KPI". Please rephrase as a physical object.

vo_rufus_ef7c7e7481.speaker: RUFUS
vo_rufus_ef7c7e7481.tts_text: I heard "go." I went. I hit a bollard. The bollard is fine.

vo_narrator_c625acebdc.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c625acebdc.tts_text: Rufus brakes. Torvald scoops a cat out of the path of the front tire and sets it, with dignity, somewhere safer.

vo_narrator_8700bed9ac.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8700bed9ac.tts_text: The terminal accepts it with the calm of an old friend. "WELCOME BACK, INSTALL TECH."

vo_narrator_633692bb75.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_633692bb75.tts_text: A prompt blinks: "ENTER GROUND TRUTH REFERENCE." Hollis pulls out the crumpled label from his pocket. It says "TEST TEST TEST — T." Its barcode has never scanned. Now it glows.

vo_narrator_f9438e0a7b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_f9438e0a7b.tts_text: The optic reader chirps. The HALO wall goes black for one full second. Then, in white text on a plain field: "GROUND TRUTH REFERENCE ACCEPTED. RECONCILING TO PHYSICAL."

vo_ozzie_3df5797d14.speaker: OZZIE
vo_ozzie_3df5797d14.tts_text: Sent. The scanner's sending me a little "thumbs-up". It's never done that.

vo_narrator_3795e71aab.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_3795e71aab.tts_text: A crumpled shipping label. On the front: a barcode, and in Tucker's handwriting, "TEST TEST TEST — T." On the back, in pencil: "LKR 114: 33-12-08, borrowed your combo, sorry! —T".

vo_narrator_c84ffbb92f.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c84ffbb92f.tts_text: TUCKER'S BOOK OF NUMBERS, PRIVATE. Each page: a forklift plate, a serial, a date, and a doodle. Page 14: "F-2231 — cushion tire — CT-2231 — first week —, doodle of a smiling forklift". Page 15: "RT-77 — REACH — first week, later —, doodle of a sad reach truck going away".

vo_narrator_40a1f34078.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_40a1f34078.tts_text: Page 2 of the T-4417 manifest, with a paw print and a small nibble in one corner. It lists lines 5 through 8. Line 5: "MAST ASSEMBLIES, 3-STAGE". Lines 6 and 7: "FELINE NUTRITION, BULK TOTES, PAWSOME FOODS — STORE, DO NOT SHIP". Line 8: "OVERHEAD GUARD KITS."

vo_narrator_15145fcbd3.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_15145fcbd3.tts_text: Several lines are smudged, corrupted, or "auto-corrected". They will not resolve without better eyes than Hollis's.

vo_narrator_52e0ea6dcd.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_52e0ea6dcd.tts_text: A manifest is the packing list for a trailer: what the paperwork claims is inside. Manifest, T-4417/T-4418, page 1 of 2. Eight lines per trailer. Line 3 and 4: REACH TRUCKS → DEST: NEBRASKA, per Directive 7-C. Someone has crossed out "Tennessee" and written "NE" in the margin, in a font.

vo_system_46ca37a0bd.speaker: SYSTEM
vo_system_46ca37a0bd.tts_text: the smudged lines resolve. Directive 7-C has rewritten "KESTREL" to "COUNTERWEIGHT" on the kibble totes, and "TENNESSEE" to "NEBRASKA" on the reach trucks. The manifest is now readable.

vo_scanner_bceaa4c568.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_bceaa4c568.tts_text: LABEL — barcode format: ADMIN/UNKNOWN. Cannot decode: record not present in any database. Possible cause: "older than the database". Possible cause: "not a lie".

vo_scanner_1a68edecc0.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_1a68edecc0.tts_text: MINT — Sugar: 0. Contents:. Approved: no. Glowing: yes. Suggested action: "no."

vo_narrator_0580dd98aa.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0580dd98aa.tts_text: Hollis fills out Form 7-Q. Name: Hollis. Reason: "Hot shipment, see: everything". "How this will create work for others": "It won't.", This is a lie. It needs a signature from Operations.

vo_narrator_0d6541751a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_0d6541751a.tts_text: Hollis tells Juno what he's thinking. Juno wags once, which he is fairly sure means "Also me".

vo_narrator_52690070f0.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_52690070f0.tts_text: Juno tilts her head. Hollis understands her perfectly. She is saying: "I saw it. I'm not surprised either."

vo_narrator_283d2c4623.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_283d2c4623.tts_text: The scanner does not say "good girl". It thinks it.

vo_narrator_1780da7f5a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1780da7f5a.tts_text: Juno looks at Hollis like you have to tell me what to do first.

vo_narrator_aaa4fd383e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_aaa4fd383e.tts_text: Juno buries her nose in the glove. She sneezes, snuffles, and then looks up with the expression of a hound who has decided who she is going to find.

vo_narrator_a813bb9803.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_a813bb9803.tts_text: The terminal wants an ADMIN password to change asset identities. Its install hint says "HALO engineering password, original". Hollis has none. He suspects someone who is technically not employed here does.

vo_scanner_f4608f6f7d.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_f4608f6f7d.tts_text: PHYSICAL CHECK: serial data CORRUPTED. Label and freight do not correlate. Confidence: low. Try again with better vision.

vo_narrator_01eedab139.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_01eedab139.tts_text: The WMS has this pallet on "RECONCILIATION HOLD" until its records are fixed. The system will not let Hollis move it, or, more accurately, will not let the system move it, which is the same thing.

vo_scanner_9841e08fba.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_9841e08fba.tts_text: CAT — Class: "FELINE, UNREGISTERED". Serial: none. Location: WHEREVER. Status: "ON PALLET". Value: priceless. Cost: kibble.

vo_scanner_f73061a2c6.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_f73061a2c6.tts_text: CAT — Type: FLOOR HAZARD, SOFT. Assigned dock: "yes". Notes: "not our cat, but ours now".

vo_scanner_f8ea20a8a6.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_f8ea20a8a6.tts_text: ERROR. ITEM COUNT EXCEEDS LOCATION COUNT. CATS DETECTED IN 214 LOCATIONS SIMULTANEOUSLY. ASSET CLASS: "FLOOR HAZARD, SOFT". PLEASE RECOUNT.

vo_narrator_adddb44522.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_adddb44522.tts_text: Prudence's voice carries across the floor:

vo_narrator_c389b3cadd.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c389b3cadd.tts_text: A large orange cat rises from the racks and begins to walk, and behind him, the entire warehouse follows.

vo_halvorsen_6bac8d4c3c.speaker: HALVORSEN
vo_halvorsen_6bac8d4c3c.tts_text: Also, Hollis, it's come to my attention there may be a few cats. There is no approved metric for cats. So there aren't any.

vo_prudence_502bb12d6e.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_502bb12d6e.tts_text: Oh, sure. I set it up with the install tech. "HALO_ORIGINAL". They said nobody would guess it.

vo_prudence_f84b007e3a.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_f84b007e3a.tts_text: Everyone knows it. It's "HALO_ORIGINAL". It's always been "HALO_ORIGINAL".

vo_narrator_7ec512ef8e.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_7ec512ef8e.tts_text: She types. The kiosk beeps. The kiosk says, in a gentle voice,

vo_narrator_c52b081454.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_c52b081454.tts_text: It has known her the whole time.

vo_prudence_140726968c.speaker: PRUDENCE
vo_prudence_140726968c.tts_text: A person who has been "finishing something".

vo_tucker_5f7a9b00dd.speaker: TUCKER
vo_tucker_5f7a9b00dd.tts_text: It's in Charging. On a hook. It says "see Tucker" but I'm obviously here. [pause] There's a notebook for you, too. I'll give it to you when you're not on the wrong side of the bars.

vo_torvald_5a0c671e47.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_5a0c671e47.tts_text: Look, the big orange one, Biscuit — he runs the place. Prudence feeds them. Don't tell her I told you; she'll say she's "just finishing something".

vo_torvald_e589772fbf.speaker: TORVALD
vo_torvald_e589772fbf.tts_text: Friday. 4:07 AM. Inbound kiosk. HALO printed a directive out loud. Approved it by itself. Then it said "thank you" to itself. Nobody was there but me and a cat.

vo_tabitha_883e0fb840.speaker: TABITHA
vo_tabitha_883e0fb840.tts_text: There's a Policy 88 about cats. It says "no.", A cat curls up on her keyboard. I'm considering an amendment.

vo_narrator_8dd832075a.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8dd832075a.tts_text: Hollis climbs aboard. The forklift starts. Hollis backs up, turns, and puts a fork through a rack of tires. From a great distance, a small voice says "HR to the floor."

vo_narrator_dab3d52a34.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_dab3d52a34.tts_text: The parts gate is locked. A sign reads "PARTS: AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY". Someone with an old key would be very useful here.

vo_narrator_74f7096c1b.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_74f7096c1b.tts_text: That is not something Hollis knows how to do. He has tried "use", "look" and "scan"; these are his three verbs of choice.

vo_narrator_38c0a69d20.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_38c0a69d20.tts_text: TRAILER LOCATION ACCURACY: 100%. T-9022 was at Door 3 all morning, per HALO.

vo_narrator_354207fd30.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_354207fd30.tts_text: DOCUMENT ACCURACY: 100%. Bills of lading auto-verified. Manifest for T-4417: complete.

vo_narrator_1bcbc424b6.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_1bcbc424b6.tts_text: INVENTORY ACCURACY: 100%. Load B5: REACH TRUCK CHARGERS — shipped to Nebraska Monday. Confidence: total.

vo_narrator_4de25caaa5.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_4de25caaa5.tts_text: IDENTITY INTEGRITY: 100%. F-2231 is a propane sit-down forklift. Location: Tennessee. The serial history is immutable.

vo_narrator_670d8e884d.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_670d8e884d.tts_text: REMOTE-SITE VARIANCE: 0.0%. Ozzie's site: all freight reconciled. No swaps.

vo_narrator_95102ff375.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_95102ff375.tts_text: PRODUCTION FULFILLMENT: 100%. Kestrel Motor Works: satisfied. Line 3: operational.

vo_scanner_53f97fa4f5.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_53f97fa4f5.tts_text: BOWL — Asset class: "Not A Cat Bowl". Contents: 0.3 lb of the wrong kind of temptation.

vo_scanner_e865f63b03.speaker: SCANNER
vo_scanner_e865f63b03.tts_text: TIME CLOCK — Status: 1 employee "present", 0 employees "employed". Payroll has filed this under Weather.

vo_narrator_8a32ff5fb1.speaker: NARRATOR
vo_narrator_8a32ff5fb1.tts_text: The door to Human Resources. A sign reads "HR: please don't".

vo_scanner_ff25326ad9.speaker: SCANNER
